| 889 | **hot-swap: structural layer edits didn't cancel pending per-layer staged swaps (both products)** Found in the cross-product deep-dive audit. A per-layer hot-swap is staged by **index** in the stager; `addVoice`/`removeVoice`/`swapVoices`/`resetVoice` (mu-tant) and `addRhythm`/`removeRhythm`/`swapRhythms`/`resetRhythm` (mu-clid) shift/swap/clear slot data by index but never touched the stager — so a swap staged while playing, followed by a structural edit before the loop boundary, would commit to the **wrong slot** (a down-shift renumbers everything from the edit point; a swap transposes two slots; a removed index could go out of `numActive…` range and sit pending until a later grow re-commits stale data). Non-crashing (the install is a valid move) but wrong data. Fix: the structural-edit functions now cancel the affected pending per-layer swaps — `removeVoice`/`removeRhythm` cancel **all** (the renumber invalidates every higher index), `swap*` cancel the two slots, `reset*`/`add*` cancel the touched slot. A staged **full** preset is index-independent (replaces the whole state at commit) so it is left to win. mu-tant via `hotSwapStager.cancelVoice`, mu-clid via `hotSwapStager.cancelPendingIfAny`. 127 + 140 tests green. **NOTE:** mu-clid built + tested Debug only this session — needs a Release build to deploy the fix to testers. | ✅ Closed | 776 |

| 888 | **mu-tant hot-swap: decode wavetables OFF the lock at stage time (kill the residual ~1-in-10 pause)** After #886 the *commit* was lock-free, but the *stage* (`preloadWavetablesFromState` → `bank.addOrLoadFile` under `voicesLock`) still did the whole WAV decode + FFT mip-build **inside** `voicesLock` — so loading a *new* preset every loop (stress test) decoded a new table under the lock at select time and the audio render bailed to silence for the decode duration ~1 in 10. Split `WavetableBank` into a lock-free decode + a locked append: new `decodeFile()` (file read + WAV decode + FFT mips → returns a `Wavetable`, no bank access) and `appendTable()` (the brief `push_back`); refactored `buildTable`→`buildTableData` (pure) + thin wrapper, `addFromWav`→`decodeWavData` (pure) + thin wrapper. `preloadWavetablesFromVoiceTree` now `findByPath`-skips already-loaded tables, **decodes off-lock**, and takes `voicesLock` only for the microsecond `appendTable`. **Readiness gate confirmed + documented:** the staging `isReady` store-release is set only AFTER the decode+append+parse complete, and `checkBoundaries` only commits `isReady` swaps — so if a loop boundary arrives before the new preset is ready, it is skipped and the swap commits at the next loop point (never a half-ready commit). 127 tests green. | ✅ Closed | 775 |

| 887 | **docs: authoritative hot-swap reference** Deep-dived mu-clid's hot-swap (per-rhythm + full-preset) and documented it so future work can refer to it. New [docs/mu-clid/design-hotswap.md](docs/mu-clid/design-hotswap.md): components, the stage-heavy/commit-trivial principle, threading contract (store-release/load-acquire), boundary detection (`BlockResult` wrap masks + `HotSwapBoundary` predicates + wrap-detector resets), per-rhythm + full-preset walk-throughs, **retire-then-swap** voice tail, `processSwaps`, staging badges + commit callbacks, offline `RenderMode` flush, edge cases. Added a family-level **Hot-swap** section to [docs/design-plugin-family.md](docs/design-plugin-family.md) — the shared pattern, the product-side decision, the mu-clid-vs-mu-tant table, and the hard-won lock lessons (commit takes no blanket lock; resolve resources lock-free at commit per #886; advance transport outside the render lock; clear editor callbacks in dtor). Fixed the stale "mu-tant has no hot-swap" line. Cross-linked from mu-clid/mu-tant CLAUDE.md design-doc tables + design-presets.md. Docs only. | ✅ Closed | 774 |

| 886 | **mu-tant hot-swap: remove the last intermittent swap pause — resolve wavetables lock-free at commit** (follow-up to #885) After #885 the swap was seamless for index-based presets but still paused *intermittently* ("not every time") for presets whose oscillators select a table from the **Wavetables content folder** (selected **by path**, per #874). `readVoiceDataFromState` / `applyVoicePresetTree` resolved those paths at commit via `bank.addOrLoadFile()` **under `voicesLock`** — and any `voicesLock` hold, however brief, makes the audio render's `ScopedTryLock` bail to a full silent block for whatever block coincides (hence intermittent). Fix: at commit, resolve the bank index with the lock-free `WavetableBank::findByPath()` first (the hot-swap **stage** already pre-loaded every referenced table into the bank via `preloadWavetablesFromState`/`preloadWavetablesFromVoiceTree`), falling back to the locked `addOrLoadFile` disk load **only** when the table isn't already in the bank (stopped / immediate / host-restore paths, where the audio is silent or suspended anyway). The boundary commit now takes **no** `voicesLock` at all for a preloaded preset, so the render never bails → no pause. `findByPath` is a const read of the bank's table list; safe concurrent with the audio thread's by-index reads since no append happens during a commit (all appends are message-thread, serialised with the commit). 127 tests green. | ✅ Closed | 774 |

| 885 | **mu-tant hot-swap: kill the swap-time transport freeze + silence gap, and wire the staging badges** (follow-up to #880/#883/#884) Two defects on a full-preset hot-swap while playing (factory tables): (1) **no staging badge** — the shared `TransportBar` "SWP" pill polls `ProcessorBase::hasPendingFullPreset()` and the shared `ChannelSidebar` polls `isPendingSwap(i)`, but mu-tant never overrode the former nor wired the latter, so neither badge showed. Added `PluginProcessor::hasPendingFullPreset()`→`hotSwapStager.hasFullPending()`, `hasPendingSwap(v)`/`cancelStagedSwap(v)`→ per-voice stager, and wired `VoiceSidebar.isPendingSwap`/`onCancelPendingSwap`. (2) **transport froze + audio went silent at the commit** — `applyFullPresetTree` ran the whole `replaceState` + `readVoiceDataFromState` + `syncAllFxParams` under a blanket `voicesLock`, so every `processBlock` bailed at its `tryLock` for the duration → multi-block silence AND a frozen `internalBeatPos` (the early-return also skipped the beat advance). Fix: (a) dropped the blanket lock from `applyFullPresetTree` — every structure it touches is already guarded by its own fine-grained lock the audio render respects (params atomic via `replaceState`; gates via `editLock` in `deserialiseGate`; modulators via `modLock` in `deserialise/clearModulators`; bank append self-locks), so the commit now runs concurrently with the render (a concurrent block sees old-or-new per structure, ≤1 block, inaudible) instead of silencing it; (b) restructured `processBlock` so the transport snapshot + beat advance + hot-swap boundary check run OUTSIDE the render `tryLock` (atomics only) → the transport never freezes even if the render momentarily bails. 127 tests green. | ✅ Closed | 773 |

| 884 | **mu-tant: MIDI program-change preset loading (Ch 1-8 → voice slots, Ch 9 → full preset) + Settings page parity with mu-clid** Same model as mu-clid, reusing the mu-core `ProcessorBase` machinery (`scanMidiProgramChanges` / `drainPendingMidiProgramChanges` / `midiPresetMap` + `midiFullPresetMap`) and the shared `MidiPresetsPanel` / `MidiFullPresetsPanel` overlays. **Processor:** ctor points both maps at `<settingsDir>/muTant_midiPresets.json` + `muTant_midiFullPresets.json` and `.load()`s them; `processBlock` names the MidiBuffer + `if (scanMidiProgramChanges(midi)) triggerAsyncUpdate();` (before the voicesTryLock so PCs aren't dropped during a voice edit); `handleAsyncUpdate` calls `drainPendingMidiProgramChanges()`; the two apply hooks now route `applyMidiPresetSlot(slot,f) → loadVoicePreset(slot,f)` and `applyFullMidiPreset(f) → loadPreset(f)` (both hot-swap, so a PC defers to the loop boundary while playing). **Settings:** added a "MIDI Prog. Change" row to `SettingsOverlay` with **Voice Presets** + **Full Presets** buttons (`onMidiPresetsClicked` / `onFullPresetsClicked`); `PluginEditor` opens the shared overlays via `showMidiPresets(true)` / `showMidiFullPresets(true)` (their onClose returns to settings). The per-voice table browses `.muPattern`/`Voices`, the full table `.muTant`/`Presets`, via the existing `ProcessorBase` virtuals. | ✅ Closed | 771 |

| 883 | **mu-tant: per-voice (`.muPattern`) hot-swap — apply at THAT voice's own loop boundary** `loadVoicePreset` now parses to a ValueTree and, while playing, stages it in `VoiceHotSwapStager` (pre-loading referenced wavetables into the bank so the commit is disk-free), committing at the voice's **own** gate-pattern wrap (`gatePatterns[voice].patternLengthBars * 4`); while stopped it applies immediately. The apply body was factored into `applyVoicePresetTree(voice, tree)` (params via `setValueNotifyingHost` + deserialise modulators/gate/filter/pitch + resolve wavetables; per-pattern `editLock`s guard the audio thread, no `voicesLock`). `handleAsyncUpdate` drains committed voice swaps + fires `onVoiceHotSwapCommitted(voice)` → the editor refreshes that voice's sidebar glyph + (if shown) re-binds the panel (knobs + wavetable dropdowns). Supersede (re-stage overwrites the slot) + stop-edge commit covered by tests. | ✅ Closed | 771 |

| 882 | **mu-core ModulatorEditor: Step selector left-justified next to the other controls, dice alone on the right** Follow-up to #873. In `ModulatorEditor::resized()` the Step group (label + note dropdown + "× N") was right-anchored against the dice, leaving a gap after the Loop group. Now it left-flows from the running `x` immediately after the Loop group (label → dropdown → "× N"), with only the dice anchored at `w - diceW`. Shared mu-core (both products). | ✅ Closed | 770 |

| 881 | **mu-core filter: LP12 / all 12 dB SVF modes were very quiet — normalized resonance fed to the SVF as Q** The four SVF algorithms (`Lp12`/`Hp12`/`Bp12`/`Notch12`) passed the normalized `flt_res` (0..0.99, default 0.2) straight to `juce::dsp::StateVariableTPTFilter::setResonance`, which expects a **Q**. Q=0.2 is heavily over-damped (~-8 dB half an octave below cutoff, -14 dB at cutoff) → gutted passband, "very quiet"/dull; the Ladder modes correctly read 0..1 as resonance, so LP12 sounded quiet next to LP24. Added `mu_filter::svfResonanceToQ()` in `FilterAlgorithmBase.h` — maps res=0 → Q=0.707 (Butterworth, flat/full passband) rising exponentially to ~7.9 at res→1 — and routed all four SVF algorithms through it. Shared mu-core, so mu-clid's SVF filters get the same correction (a deliberate character change; the old behaviour was an over-damped bug). 120 tests green. | ✅ Closed | 770 |

| 880 | **mu-tant: full-preset hot-swap — stage and switch at the loop boundary (product-side; mu-clid `HotSwapStager` NOT centralised to mu-core)** Implemented product-side per this session's decision (the mu-clid payload + boundary semantics are mu-clid-specific; only the ~30-line handshake is shared — a generic `mu-core BoundaryStager<Payload>` is deferred). `PluginProcessor` is now a `juce::AsyncUpdater`. `loadPreset` parses to a ValueTree and, while playing, pre-loads referenced wavetables + stages via `VoiceHotSwapStager::stageFull`, committing at **voice 0's** gate-pattern wrap; stopped → applies immediately. Boundary detection runs on the raw pre-ceiling beat position (`floor` loop-index crossing, so non-divisor lengths like 12/20 beats work) plus a playing→stopped edge (apply-on-stop). The immediate apply, the boundary commit, and host state-restore all share `applyFullPresetTree` (replaceState + numVoices + colours + readVoiceDataFromState + syncAllFxParams, under `voicesLock`). Commit fires `ProcessorBase::onPresetSwapCommitted` → editor re-runs `onPresetLoaded` (the shell's synchronous post-load refresh would otherwise paint stale state); editor clears both swap callbacks in its dtor (processor-outlives-editor UAF guard). Pure boundary predicates live in `Source/Plugin/HotSwapBoundary.h`; staging state machine in `Source/Plugin/VoiceHotSwapStager.h` — both header-only, unit-tested in `HotSwapBoundaryTests.cpp` (7 groups: wrap incl. non-divisors, stop-edge, full vs per-voice boundary, supersede, full-supersedes-voice). 127 tests green. | ✅ Closed | 771 |

| 879 | **mu-tant: wavetable selection not restored in the dropdown after loading a preset (looked unsaved)** The data was always persisted correctly (verified on disk: `o1WtPath` on the `<Voice>` element + factory `o{1,2}_wt` in APVTS; `readVoiceDataFromState` re-resolves to a bank index so the engine/sound loaded the right table). Bug was UI-only: `refreshWavetableDropdowns()` ran only inside `rebindAttachments()`, which `setVoice()` skips when the voice index is unchanged — and preset load calls `onPresetLoaded → setVoice(0)` while already on voice 0, so the dropdowns never rebuilt and showed the stale selection. Fixed by calling `refreshWavetableDropdowns()` unconditionally in `setVoice()` alongside the other unconditional re-binds. | ✅ Closed | 770 |

| 878 | **mu-link: new product — local audio receiver + master clock for the mu family (umbrella tracker — COMPLETE)** New sibling product. Role: present a low-latency audio sink that multiple mu standalone apps (mu-clid, mu-tant, future) output to, **sum** their streams, and render to one hardware device; **and** act as the family's rock-solid master clock so all products stay sample-accurately in sync. **Model (locked):** a **JACK-style local audio server with a shared-memory IPC bus** (NOT a system-wide virtual audio driver). mu-link owns the single hardware device (WASAPI/ASIO) and runs the one audio callback; clients push audio into per-client shared-memory ring buffers and read a shared **transport block** (sample position + tempo + play state) updated every callback — the hardware word clock IS the master clock (±0 drift), sidestepping MIDI-clock jitter. Click-avoidance via async double-buffered rings (underrun → silence, never glitches the master). Client side is a `mu-core` module (`MuLinkClient`) that swaps the JUCE output device for the bus and slaves `HostTransport`; falls back to its own device when mu-link isn't running. Outward bridge: real MIDI-clock OUT to outboard gear (no Ableton Link — avoids GPL). **STANDALONE-ONLY** — VST3/CLAP are never touched (host owns clock + audio I/O); every hook gated on `wrapperType_Standalone`; auto-detect via `OpenFileMapping`, self-register in the `ClientRegistry`, any launch order; reverts cleanly to its own device if mu-link quits mid-session. **All stages shipped:** **L1 ✅** (#893) Win32 shared-memory bus. **L2 ✅** (#895) `ServerEngine` + device-owning `AudioServer` + `mu-link-server`. **L3 ✅** (#897) GUI app (device picker, client/master meters, master transport). **L4 ✅** (#898) IPC contract + client glue lifted to `mu-core/Link/`. **L5 ✅** (#899) mu-clid standalone-only wired onto `MuLinkClient`. **L6 ✅** (#901) per-client gain/pan/mute/solo + master gain + GUI strips + heartbeat reaping; master soft-clip (#903). **L7 ✅** (#904) external MIDI-clock sync (slave mode) via a tempo PLL. **Shipped to testers at v1.0.782** (#905); **mu-Tant wired ✅** (#902) via the shared `mu-core/Link/MuLinkBridge.h` + `HostTransport` position standard. **CLOSED — manual hardware validation (tested OK at v1.0.793):** outboard MIDI sync confirmed against real gear, tested both ways — mu-clid slaved through mu-link (the bus carries clock + audio) **and** mu-clid standalone on its own (direct external-MIDI slave). The last umbrella residual (outboard MIDI-clock-OUT vs. real hardware) is cleared — mu-link is complete. | ✅ Closed | 793 |

| 877 | **mu-tant wavetable: dropdown categories via sub-folders** (#874 follow-up 3) `VoicePanel::refreshWavetableDropdowns` ([VoicePanel.cpp:787](mu-tant/Source/UI/VoicePanel.cpp#L787)) now scans the `Wavetables` content folder **recursively** and groups files by their containing sub-folder: each sub-folder becomes its own `addSectionHeading` (nested paths shown `Parent / Child`), files in the root stay under "Wavetables". Sorted by (category, natural filename) — root files first, sub-folders alphabetically. Item IDs stay path-based (`kWtFolderBase + i`) so selection / persistence are unchanged; the "in folder" test was switched from a parent==root check to membership in the scanned list so sub-folder tables select via their own item (not the out-of-folder fallback). Drop a folder of `.wav` into `Wavetables/FM/` etc. and they appear under an "FM" heading. | ✅ Closed | 769 |

| 876 | **mu-tant wavetable: parse Serum `clm ` chunk for frame size** (#874 follow-up 2) `WavetableBank::addFromWav` previously hard-assumed `kFrameSize = 2048` samples/frame, mis-slicing Serum/Vital tables authored at other single-cycle lengths. Added a file-static `parseSerumFrameSize(data, numBytes)` ([WavetableBank.cpp](mu-tant/Source/Audio/WavetableBank.cpp)) that walks the RIFF chunk list for `clm ` and reads the integer after `<!>` (e.g. `"<!>1024 10000000 wavetable (...)"`). `addFromWav` uses the detected size when it's a power of two in `[kMinMipSize, 8192]` (FFT-order requirement), else falls back to `kFrameSize`; per-table `mipSize` already drives runtime sampling so non-2048 frames need no further change. New test splices a `clm ` chunk declaring 1024 into a 4096-sample WAV and asserts 4 frames (not 2). 120 tests green. | ✅ Closed | 769 |

| 875 | **mu-core filter Drive: full unity-gain makeup collapses level past ~30% (thinned instead of fattening)** The pre-filter valve saturation in `MultiModeFilter::process` ([MultiModeFilter.cpp:82-95](mu-core/Audio/MultiModeFilter.cpp#L82-L95)) applied `preGain = 1 + drv·5` (1×..6×) then compensated with the **full inverse** `invGain = 1/preGain`. As drive rose, peaks clamped into the flat region of the tanh/algebraic curve while the makeup pulled the whole signal back down by the full gain — a 0.5-peak input dropped to ~0.34 at 30% drive and ~0.17 at 100%. Harmonics arrived but level collapsed → "lost body" rather than beefing up. Fix (option 1, loudness-neutral): makeup is now **`1/√preGain`** so quiet passages get boosted by the residual gain (adds thickness) and saturated peaks hold their level instead of being attenuated — same 0.5 input → ~0.41 at both 30% and 100%: level holds while harmonics build. One-line change in shared mu-core → mu-clid benefits too. The ×5 pre-gain ceiling and the asymmetric (tanh / x/(1−x)) curve are unchanged. | ✅ Closed | 768 |

| 873 | **mu-core ModulatorEditor: step "× N" multiplier hidden behind the dice button** Follow-up to #872. The control peeping behind the dice was identified as the **step-length multiplier `stepMult`** ("× N" nudge, Stepped mode) — it was left-flowed and the right-anchored dice landed on top of it when the header was tight (#872's opaque fill merely hid it). Fix: in `ModulatorEditor::resized()`, place the dice first at `w - diceW`, then **right-anchor the step group** (label + note dropdown + "× N") immediately to the dice's left (`diceX - gap8 - nmW`, walking leftward), so the multiplier is always fully visible. The loop group still flows from the left; in Smooth mode (no step group) it never reaches the dice. | ✅ Closed | 762 |

| 872 | **mu-core ModulatorEditor: dice (randomise) glyph too small + header control peeping through it** `diceBtn` was a `juce::TextButton` rendering ⚀ at the small default button font with a transparent background, so it was hard to read and a header control underlapping it showed through. Replaced with a custom `DiceButton : juce::Button` (nested in `ModulatorEditor.h`) that fills an opaque `panelBackground` rect (covers underlap → no peeping) and draws ⚀ centred at 0.78× button height with hover/down brightening. Shared mu-core — both products benefit. | ✅ Closed | 761 |

| 870 | **[Audit] mu-tant: asymmetric filter cutoff defaults made a freshly-added second filter silently transparent** `flt2_cut` defaulted to 20000 Hz (an LP/HP at 20 kHz is effectively a bypass) vs `flt_cut`'s 8000 Hz, so filter 2 appeared to "do nothing" until its cutoff was lowered (the #864 confusion). Changed `flt2_cut` default to 8000 Hz to match filter 1 in `PluginProcessor_APVTS.cpp`, so adding a second filter is audible out of the box. (Affects new/default state only; saved presets carry their own explicit value.) | ✅ Closed | 759 |

| 869 | **[Audit] HIGH — `FilterRoutingButton` destructor missing `stopTimer()` (use-after-free)** The class derives from `juce::Timer` and runs a 60 Hz rotation animation, but `~FilterRoutingButton()` only removed the toggle-state Value listener — a timer tick could fire on a partially-destroyed object during teardown (window close / voice-switch mid-animation). Added `stopTimer();` to the destructor. Same class of bug as #483-485. (Introduced earlier this session in #861/#864.) | ✅ Closed | 759 |

| 868 | **[Audit] MED — filter cutoff not clamped against Nyquist (SVF/Ladder instability at fs ≤ 40 kHz)** The 20 kHz APVTS cutoff ceiling exceeded Nyquist at sample rates ≤ 40 kHz; `StateVariableTPTFilter`/`LadderFilter` assert (debug) or destabilise (release) above fs/2. Added a central clamp in `MultiModeFilter::process` — `safeCut = jlimit(20, 0.45·sampleRate, cutoff)` applied before algorithm dispatch, and the post-filter lo-cut is clamped with `jmin(loHz, maxCut)` — so every one of the 16 algorithms is protected regardless of caller. `MultiModeFilter` now stores `currentSampleRate` (set in `prepare`). | ✅ Closed | 759 |

| 867 | **[Audit] LOW — JUCE SVF + Ladder wrappers recomputed coefficients every block with no dirty-check** Added `lastCutoffHz`/`lastResonance` caching to all eight JUCE-wrapped algorithms (`Lp12/Hp12/Bp12/Notch12` SVF + `Lp24/Hp24/Bp24/Notch24` Ladder): `setCutoffFrequency`/`setResonance` now only fire when cutoff or resonance actually changed, matching the existing skip in the custom-biquad and 1-pole algorithms. `reset()` invalidates the cache so coefficients re-apply after a state reset. Eliminates per-block trig recompute when the knobs are static. | ✅ Closed | 759 |

| 864 | **mu-tant: filter Series/Parallel toggle glyph desynced from actual state → "filter2 has no effect" confusion** Reported as "2nd filter in series has no effect." Investigation showed the dual-filter DSP path is correct and symmetric — `readConfig` loads all `filter2*` params, `setConfig` applies them identically to filter1, and series runs `filter1.process`→`filter2.process` on the same buffer; filter2 IS applied. Root cause of the confusion: `FilterRoutingButton`'s rotation glyph only updated in `clicked()`, so it never tracked toggle changes from preset load / DAW automation / voice-rebind (`setVoice`) — the displayed mode could be wrong (screenshots showed ‖/Parallel while `flt_series` defaults to Series). Fix: glyph now driven from `getToggleStateValue()` via a `juce::Value::Listener` (`valueChanged`) so it syncs from any source; snaps on first sync (no spin on load), animates the 90° rotation on later changes; `clicked()` override removed. Secondary note (not a bug): `flt2_cut` defaults to 20000 Hz (transparent LP) vs filter1's 8000 Hz, so a freshly-added second filter is inaudible until its cutoff is lowered. Tests green (0/115). | ✅ Closed | 757 |

| 863 | **mu-tant: stale unit tests reference removed `xmod`/`xmode` params (17 failures)** Pre-existing test debt from #858 (which replaced `xmod`/`xmode` with `xmod_fm`/`xmod_am`/`xmod_ring` and the dest key `xmod` with `xmod.fm`/`xmod.am`/`xmod.ring`) — two test lists were never updated. `ApvtsLayoutTests.cpp` per-voice param list: `"xmod","xmode"` → `"xmod_fm","xmod_am","xmod_ring"`. `ModulatorTests.cpp` required-dest-key list: `"xmod"` → `"xmod.fm","xmod.am","xmod.ring"`. All 17 failures cleared; suite green. Unrelated to #862 (discovered while running tests to verify the comb fix). | ✅ Closed | 756 |

| 862 | **mu-tant/mu-core: Comb filter clicks under stepped cutoff modulation** A patch with Filter = Comb + a **Stepped** modulator on **Filter Cutoff** produced loud clicks on every step. Root cause in the **shared mu-core** `CombPlusFilter`/`CombMinusFilter`: the delay length (`delayF = sampleRate / cutoffHz`) was recomputed once per block from the **raw** cutoff and never smoothed, so a discrete cutoff jump moved the delay-line read tap discontinuously → a click. (Resonance was already smoothed; cutoff was not. Neither `VoiceEngine` (mu-clid) nor `SynthVoice` (mu-tant) slew-limits cutoff, so this affected **all** products that modulate a comb's cutoff — mu-clid only avoided it by not exercising that patch.) Fix: added a per-sample-smoothed `smoothedDelay` (`SmoothedValue`, 10 ms) to both comb filters; the ramp is pre-computed into a `delayRamp` scratch vector (sized at `prepare`) so every channel reads the identical glide (no L/R click). Stepped cutoff now glides the resonant pitch over 10 ms instead of clicking. Header-only change in mu-core → both products benefit. | ✅ Closed | 756 |

(4) **Animation**: 90° rotation between Series (0°, ═) and Parallel (90°, ‖) via 60 Hz `timerCallback` lerp, retained. Also fixed a pre-existing compile error in the uncommitted `paintButton` (`PathStrokeType` 2nd arg must be `JointStyle`, not `EndCapStyle` → `mitered, square`) and removed three unused locals (`xmodTitleW`, `typeLblW`, `typeDdW`). | 844 | **Sidechain input bus declared as Vst::kMain instead of Vst::kAux — DAW never shows sidechain routing pin** Root cause: JUCE maps the first input bus to `Vst::kMain` by default unless `VST3ClientExtensions::getPluginHasMainInput()` returns false. Fix: added `SidechainVST3Extensions` (overrides `getPluginHasMainInput() = false`) to `ProcessorBase`, and overrode `getVST3ClientExtensions()` on `ProcessorBase` to return it. | 839 | **Root-cause analysis: how #837 was possible** `ProcessorBase::processCoreBlock` accepts pre-computed `effectiveBpm` and a render callback — it intentionally does not read the host playhead, delegating transport entirely to each product's `processBlock`. mu-clid has `deriveTransport`/`computeLiteTransport` that read `getPlayHead()`. mu-tant was written without this, leaving `playing` always `false` in plugin mode; `applyGateBlock(playing=false)` returns `GateMode::Silence` unconditionally. The existing unit tests could not catch this because they call `applyGateBlock` directly (no DAW context). Fixed architecturally by #840. | ✅ Closed | 733 |

| 757 | **[family — delay→reverb intra-FX send broken in mu-tant/mu-toni (dly2rev not reaching engine)]** Moving the "Rev" send knob on the delay return strip in the mixer had no effect on the reverb level. Root cause: `mu_mixfx::isGlobalFxParamId` checked for `"dly_"` prefix but `"dly2rev"` starts with `"dly2"`, so mu-tant/mu-toni's `parameterChanged` never routed it to `syncGlobalFxParam` → `fxChain.setDelayToReverbSend`. (mu-clid's hand-rolled dispatch list already had `"dly2"` — #720 port gap.) Fixed by adding `id.startsWith("dly2")` to `isGlobalFxParamId`. Also added `"eff2"` and `"dly2"` to `MixerOverlay::isMixerRelevantParam` so automation/preset-load correctly marks the overlay dirty, and fixed `MixerOverlay::loadFromAPVTS` to explicitly reload `eff2dly`, `eff2rev`, `dly2rev` into the return strip send knobs (these params live outside the `ret_*_` prefix scheme so the standard prefix-based reload missed them). | ✅ Closed | 712 |

| 756 | **[mu-tant — filter envelope slew-limited to match gate (eliminates clicks when envelopes out of sync)]** Filter envelope was being read directly without the 10 ms rise-limiting slew applied to the gate envelope, causing clicks when gate opened slowly but filter jumped instantly (e.g. filter 0→100 on attack while gate was ramping). Added `filterLevel` state field to `GatePattern` (analogous to `gateLevel`), applies same `maxRise` slew cap in `renderVoice` filter envelope block. Filter envelope now ramps at the same rate as gate on rising edge, preventing frequency-response artifacts when the two are out of sync. Backwards-compatible (no preset changes). | ✅ Closed | 711 |

MixerOverlay per-channel + return sidechain dropdowns show a new **"Ext In"** item (ID 10, maps apvts↔engine cleanly through existing formula). Backward-compatible: existing presets with scSrc 0–8 unchanged; 9 is a new opt-in value. | ✅ Closed | 711 |

Fixed to use `juce::CharPointer_UTF8("\xce\xbc-...")` matching mu-clid's pattern. PLUGIN_NAME in mu-clid CMakeLists remains `"μ-Clid"` / `"μ-Clid Lite"` (reverted a temporary ASCII change). | 753 | **[mu-tant — filter envelope adds to base cutoff (was replacing it)]** Formula was multiplicative: `baseProp * (1 − depth*(1−fEnvVal))`, sweeping the filter from 0 Hz up to the base cutoff. Correct behaviour is additive: `clamp(baseProp + depth*fEnvVal)`, so envelope value 0 leaves the filter at its base cutoff and rising values open it above that point. Fixed in `PluginProcessor.cpp` `renderVoice` filter envelope block. | ✅ Closed | 710 |

Mode persisted to appSettings. `midiNoteMode`, `midiHeldNotes`, `noteModePlaying`, `noteModeBeatPos` atomics on `PluginProcessor`; `deriveTransport` branched on mode. Architecture prepared for future per-channel (ch 1–8 / ch 9) and pitch-transpose note control. | ✅ Closed | 711 |

| 751 | **[mu-tant — flt_type APVTS param changed from AudioParameterInt to AudioParameterChoice (fixes filter dropdown off-by-one)]** `AudioParameterInt(0, 15, 0)` + `ComboBoxAttachment` was broken: the attachment mapped the combo's selected ID (1-based) directly to the parameter value, so LP12 (ID 1) was stored as type 1 (HP12), and the default type 0 produced combo ID 0 = no selection displayed. Fixed by changing `flt_type` to `AudioParameterChoice` (matching the pattern of `xmode` and `noise_type`). Raised `GatePattern::kMinAttackMs` to **10 ms** ([GatePattern.h](mu-tant/Source/Sequencer/GatePattern.h)) — ~half a 50 Hz period, gradual enough to be click-free; mu-tant is a drone (no transients) so the longer floor costs nothing. Slew mechanism + falling/decay edges unchanged. `GateStageTests` "opens by end of block" now renders a block sized from `kMinAttackMs` (value-agnostic); CLAUDE.md + test comments updated off the stale 3 ms. 68/68 mu-tant; 140/140 mu-clid; boundary PASS. v1.0.699. | ✅ Closed | 699 |

Slew state (`GatePattern::gateLevel`) persists across blocks and resets when the gate is held closed; `applyGateBlock` gained a `sampleRate` arg and `renderVoice` passes `currentSampleRate`. `GateStageTests` updated (the "opens at start" assertion now expects the ramp) + a new test pins the ~3 ms ramp + per-sample slope cap. 65/65 mu-tant tests; standalone smoke OK. v1.0.696. **Note:** instant *closes* (a `split=1` region into silence, or a Gap edge) aren't slewed — add a release-side minimum if those click too. | ✅ Closed | 696 |

| 707 | **[mu-family — mu-tant routed onto the shared MixerEngine via a per-channel render hook (engine→insert→mixer)]** mu-tant's `processBlock` no longer reimplements the channel mix. A new optional `MixerEngine::RenderChannelFn` hook ([mu-core/Audio/MixerEngine.h:38](mu-core/Audio/MixerEngine.h#L38)) lets a product fill each channel buffer in Phase 1 (instead of `voices[r]->process`); `processCoreBlock` forwards it ([mu-core/Plugin/ProcessorBase.cpp:92](mu-core/Plugin/ProcessorBase.cpp#L92)). **mu-clid is byte-identical** — the hook defaults null, so its `voices[r]->process` path is unchanged. **mu-tant** populates `mixerEngine.channels[]` + master from the cached APVTS atomics each block and calls `processCoreBlock(buffer, nullptr, …, &renderVoiceCb)`, deleting its inline level/pan/mute/solo + master-fader loop; the per-voice modulation→engine→gate→insert moves into `renderVoice()` ([mu-tant/Source/Plugin/PluginProcessor.cpp](mu-tant/Source/Plugin/PluginProcessor.cpp)). Consequences: the `MixerOverlay` VU meters (`channelPeaks`) now update; the shared FX-send/sidechain/return/direct-out path is now reachable (still inert until mu-tant declares those params); the family **−6 dB headroom trim + linear pan law** now apply to mu-tant (a deliberate level/pan change vs the old un-trimmed equal-power sum). Boundary PASS (145 mu-core files); mu-clid 140/140 + mu-tant 35/35; both standalones smoke-clean. Debug+Release v1.0.689. **Verify (GUI/audio, not unit-covered):** mu-tant level/pan/mute/solo + master + live mixer VU behave; mu-clid audio unchanged. | ✅ Closed | 689 |

| 706 | **[mu-family — modulator (de)serialise lifted to mu-core; mu-tant now persists modulators + gate]** The generic `ControlSequence` + `ModulationMatrix` (de)serialise is lifted to **`mu-core/Modulation/ModulatorSerialise.h`** (operates on the shared `VoiceSlot`; source/destination ID validators are injectable `std::function`s). mu-clid's `Persistence/ModulatorSerialise.h` becomes a thin `Rhythm&` adapter that injects its `ModDest` validators, so every mu-clid call site + test is unchanged — **140/140**, incl. the round-trip + dropped-assignment tests that now exercise the lifted code. **mu-tant** serialises each voice's modulators + drawable gate into a `<VoiceData>` child of the APVTS state (`writeVoiceDataToState`/`readVoiceDataFromState`) on full-state + `.muTant` save/load, and into each `.muPattern` on per-voice save/load — previously a saved patch silently lost every modulator assignment + drawn gate envelope. Gate (de)serialise is mu-tant-local (GatePattern is a mu-tant type), guarded by `editLock`; modulator restore is guarded by `modLock`. Boundary PASS (145 mu-core files); 35/35 mu-tant. v1.0.689. **Verify (not unit-covered for mu-tant):** assign a modulator + draw a gate, save + reload → both restored. | ✅ Closed | 689 |

| 705 | **[mu-tant — internalBpm made atomic (audio-thread data race fixed)]** `internalBpm` was a plain `double` written by `setInternalBpm` (message thread, BPM box) and read every block by `processBlock` for `beatsPerSample` + passed as `effectiveBpm` — a non-atomic concurrent read/write (UB; a torn double / beat-advance glitch when changing tempo during playback). Now `std::atomic<double>` ([mu-tant/Source/Plugin/PluginProcessor.h:214](mu-tant/Source/Plugin/PluginProcessor.h#L214)) with relaxed load/store in the getter/setter; `processBlock` snapshots it once into a local for the block. All per-voice + global APVTS atomics are resolved once in the constructor (`cacheParamPointers` → `voicePtrs[]` / `globalPtrs`) and read via `->load()` in `readConfig` + the mixer/gate/insert reads ([mu-tant/Source/Plugin/PluginProcessor.cpp:177](mu-tant/Source/Plugin/PluginProcessor.cpp#L177)); the old `voiceParamId`/`chId` per-block string construction (≈200+ heap allocs/block across 8 voices → realtime clicks/dropouts) is gone. | 703 | **[mu-family — insert-effect panel (InsertSubsection) lifted to mu-core; both products share it; mu-tant insert now selectable]** Final parity lift of the voice-section: mu-clid's `Source/UI/Voice/InsertSubsection.{h,cpp}` moved to **`mu-core/UI/Voice/InsertSubsection.{h,cpp}`** and generalised — the hard-coded `r{N}_` param prefix + `Rhythm`/mod-snapshot/GR/loading-flag coupling are replaced by a constructor **channel prefix** (`"r"` / `"v"`) reading APVTS via `paramFullId = prefix + idx + "_" + suffix`, plus optional `std::function` product hooks: `isSlotModulated` / `slotModValue` / `isPlaying` (mod-arc indicators), `getInsertGR` (Comp/Limiter GR meter), `runBulkChange` (wrap the 5-write algo switch). **mu-clid** keeps every feature by wiring those hooks in `VoiceSection` (prefix `"r"`): playing = `sequencerPlaying`, mod arcs from the rhythm's `modulationMatrix` assignments + `getModSnapshot`, GR from `getInsertGRReductionPtr`, and `runBulkChange` = its hot-swap `ScopedApvtsLoading` guard + `forceSyncRhythmFromAPVTS` (so the A/B snapshot + mid-sequence algo-switch behave exactly as before). The old mu-clid `InsertSubsection.{h,cpp}` is deleted (no duplication). **mu-tant** `VoicePanel` now embeds the shared panel (prefix `"v"`, constructed in the .cpp init list since the header only forward-declares `PluginProcessor`) in a new **INSERT** sub-panel placed to the right of the stacked X-Mod + Filter rows (it spans both, adding no panel height — matches mu-clid's Filter \| Insert strip and the family engine→insert→mixer flow); rebound to the active voice in `setVoice` via `setChannel`. mu-tant wires only `isPlaying` (= `isInternalPlaying`) + `getInsertGR` (new `PluginProcessor::getInsertGRPtr(int)`); insert slots aren't mod destinations in mu-tant yet and it reads insert params fresh per-block (no listener) so `runBulkChange` stays null (no guard needed). | 696 | **[mu-family — parity principle documented + mu-tant dynamic voice model (Stage 1 of the parity lift)]** Locked the family-parity working agreement: every mu-product shares ONE UX/GUI (shell, sidebar/layers, presets, panel styling, filter/insert/mixer, modulators) and only the **synth engine** differs; signal flow is `engine → insert → mixer`; all common code is centralised in mu-core (no duplication); mu-clid is the reference and every design choice gets documented. Recorded in [docs/design-plugin-family.md](docs/design-plugin-family.md) ("UX parity principle") + memory. **First implementation step — mu-tant dynamic voices (mirrors mu-clid add/delete):** mu-tant no longer has fixed 8 voices; `PluginProcessor` tracks `numVoices` (1..8, default **1**) with `addVoice()` / `removeVoice(idx)` that shift every higher voice's `v{N}_*` + `ch{N}_*` APVTS **values** down (mu-tant keeps fixed subtrees and shifts values, vs mu-clid's `Rhythm`-vector) plus the parallel `voiceSlots` (CopyableSpinLock-safe copy) + `gatePatterns` (`copyDataFrom`, since the atomic editLock blocks move). `processBlock` takes a `ScopedTryLock` on a new `voicesLock` (silences the block during an edit) and renders only the active voices; `getNumChannels()` returns `numVoices`; the count persists in the APVTS state (`numVoices` property) across full state + `.muTant` presets. Reverted the earlier "mute voices 2–8" hack — voice existence is governed by `numVoices`, not muting. 33/33 mu-tant tests pass; mu-tant Debug clean + standalone smoke-tested at v1.0.678. **Interim:** the add/delete UI is not wired yet — the sidebar still shows 8 buttons while only the active voices render; that's resolved by the next stage (lift the sidebar to mu-core as a generic `ChannelSidebar` with a per-product layer graphic, give mu-tant real add/delete, switch mu-clid to the same component). | ✅ Closed | 678 |

| 695 | **[mu-tant — gate off on load + audio test harness, single-voice default, full presets, mixer height]** Tester pass 3. **(1) Drone audible on load — fixed.** Reworked the gater: extracted the block-level decision into the shared `gateModeFor()` + `applyGateBlock()` ([GatePattern.{h,cpp}](mu-tant/Source/Sequencer/GatePattern.h)) — **bypassed → raw drone passes** (audition); **stopped → silent**; **playing + no envelopes → silent**; **playing + envelopes → per-sample envelope gate**. Previously the gate was only applied while playing, so on load (stopped) the drone passed through. `processBlock` now calls `applyGateBlock` so a freshly-loaded, stopped plugin is silent. **(2) Audio test harness** — new [GateStageTests.cpp](mu-tant/Source/Tests/GateStageTests.cpp) renders a full-scale synthetic drone buffer through `applyGateBlock` and asserts **peak == 0 on load** (stopped + no envelopes + not bypassed), plus bypass-passes, stopped-is-silent-even-with-envelopes, and playing-opens-at-envelope/silent-elsewhere. 33/33 mu-tant tests pass (was 28; +5). **(3) Default patch = single voice** — `ch{N}_mute` now defaults true for voices 2–8 (`i != 0`), so out-of-the-box one voice. **(4) Full preset system** — processor implements `getContentDir()` (`Documents/TDP/muTant`), `getPresetsDir()`/`getPerSlotPresetDir()`, `savePreset`/`loadPreset` (whole APVTS state wrapped with name/description/category in a `MuTantPreset` XML, `.muTant`), `loadCategoryList` (scans preset files); `PluginEditor` enables the TransportBar preset controls so the shared shell drives Save dialog / browser / dropdown. **(5) Mixer sub-panel height** now matches the two Osc rows (was full content height). **Build policy:** per user, mu-tant Debug-only now (no mu-clid Release until further notice). mu-tant Debug clean at v1.0.677; standalone smoke-tested (clean startup). **Deferred:** voice (per-slot `.muPattern`) presets — the shared TransportBar has no per-slot preset menu, so they need a bespoke UI surface (next pass). | ✅ Closed | 677 |

| 694 | **[mu-tant — VoicePanel layout overhaul + Gater bypass (tester pass 2)]** Reworked the voice page per tester feedback. **(1) Gater bypass** — new per-voice APVTS bool `v{N}_gate_bypass` + a "Bypass" toggle in the gating band; when on, `processBlock` skips the gate stage so the raw drone passes (audition / configuration). **Clarified per-voice behaviour:** the gater is per-voice, so with the default 8 voices all sounding, gating one voice doesn't silence the constant drone from the other seven — to hear a single gater, bypass/mute the rest or gate them too (documented; not a bug). **(2) Per-oscillator horizontal sub-panels** — each oscillator is now a bordered sub-panel with the **wavetable selector on the left**, then Oct/Semi/Fine/Pos. **(3) Voice colouring follows mu-clid** — knobs use category colours (pitch=`knobEuclidean` purple, filter=`knobPostPad` teal, levels=`knobLevel` amber, gate=`knobFxSend` coral); the Osc/Mixer sub-panel titles take the per-voice palette colour. **(4) Gap** is now a Size-2 knob. **(5) Filter + per-voice Level** use mu-clid's Size-2 knob. **(6) X-Mod mode + Noise-type dropdowns separated** into a labelled X-Mod/Noise row. **(7) Mixer sub-panel on the right** — 3 Size-3 level knobs (Osc 1 / Osc 2 / Noise) stacked vertically. Knob-size constants pulled from `mu-core` `MuLookAndFeel::kKnobSize2*/3*`. 28/28 mu-tant tests + 119/119 mu-clid tests pass; boundary PASS (136 mu-core files); mu-tant standalone smoke-tested (clean 4 s startup). Debug + Release clean at v1.0.675. **Note:** the new layout was code-verified only — the sandbox can't host the GUI, so exact spacing wants a visual pass. | ✅ Closed | 675 |

| 693 | **[mu-tant — gate editor / filter / Gap fixes from tester pass]** Six issues off the first run of the new gate editor. **(1) Pencil drew nothing + gate never gated** — `VoicePanel::setVoice(0)` (called once at editor construction) early-returned because `currentVoice` was already 0 and the attachments were already built in the ctor, so `gatingDesigner.setPattern()` / `modulatorPanel.setVoiceSlot()` never ran for the default voice → the designer's `boundPattern` stayed null (pencil no-op) and the pattern stayed empty (gate held open → drone always audible). Restructured `setVoice` to rebuild attachments only on an actual voice change but **always** (re)bind the pattern + modulator-slot pointers. **(2) Cutoff showed ~8 decimals despite the prior fix** — the slider-side `textFromValueFunction` set in the VoicePanel ctor was being clobbered by `juce::SliderParameterAttachment`'s constructor (it overwrites `textFromValueFunction`/`valueFromTextFunction` with ones that call `param.getText`) on every rebind. Moved formatting to the **parameter** via `AudioParameterFloatAttributes().withStringFromValueFunction(...)` so it survives. Cutoff now matches mu-clid: range 20..20000 Hz log-skewed to a 640 Hz dial centre (`NormalisableRange::setSkewForCentre`), value reads as a bare number, unit carried in a dynamic label (`Cutoff (Hz)` / `Cutoff (kHz)`). **(3/5) Resonance feel** — now displays the familiar 0..100 integer (slider 0..0.99 ×100) like mu-clid's filter. **(4) Gap** — changed `v{N}_gate_gap` from 0..1 (continuous) to **integer 0..100 %** with a `… %` display; consumed as `/100` in both the audio gate stage and the designer's render mirror. **(6)** Added a **placeholder wavetable-selection dropdown per oscillator** (`Osc 1 Wave` / `Osc 2 Wave`, single "Basic" entry, inert — no APVTS binding until the wavetable bank lands) in a new top row of the Oscillators band. **Note:** the gate intentionally only chops while the transport is playing — stopped = gate held open so the oscillators stay auditionable. 28/28 mu-tant tests + 119/119 mu-clid tests pass; boundary PASS (136 mu-core files); mu-tant standalone smoke-tested (clean 4 s startup). Debug + Release clean at v1.0.674. | ✅ Closed | 674 |

| 692 | **[mu-tant — drawable attack/decay gate editor + grab-handles + glue + Gap dial]** Reworked the gate model from the decay-only sketch into the interactive editor the design now specifies. **Model** ([GatePattern.{h,cpp}](mu-tant/Source/Sequencer/GatePattern.h)): `GateEnvelope` is now `startCell` + `lengthCells` + `split` (attack/decay peak position) + independent `attackBend` / `decayBend` (−1..+1, `pow(x, 2^(−bend·2))`) + `reverse` (mirror in time, swapping attack/decay). `value(phase01, gap01)` is the single shared evaluator: shape squeezed into the leading `(1−gap)` of the region, trailing `gap` forced silent. Envelopes are non-overlapping spans; `addEnvelope` trims overlaps, `removeEnvelopeCovering` removes by any interior cell, `mergeRange` glues a dragged span into one region averaging the merged shapes. `gateAt(beat, gap)` evaluates region-wide phase (not per-cell) with the cell→envelope cache. **Editor** ([GatingDesigner.{h,cpp}](mu-tant/Source/UI/GatingDesigner.h)): Pencil draws a 1-cell envelope and drags three grab-handles — top point = split, attack/decay line mid-grabs = bend — with the cursor turning to a hand on hover/drag; Eraser removes; Glue drag-merges (range highlight while dragging); Reverse flips a clicked envelope. Handles + curves render the exact gate the engine outputs (incl. the Gap silence tail). **Gap dial**: new per-voice APVTS param `v{N}_gate_gap` (0..1, shown 0–100%) + a Gap [KnobWithLabel](mu-core/UI/Components/KnobWithLabel.h) in the gating band ([VoicePanel](mu-tant/Source/UI/VoicePanel.h), rebound per voice, pushes its value into the designer for rendering); `processBlock` reads it into `gateAt`. Per-envelope probability / loop-N-of-M / properties-strip moved to "Deferred" in [design-sequencer.md](docs/mu-tant/design-sequencer.md) (rewritten to match). GatePatternTests rewritten for the new model. 28/28 mu-tant tests + 119/119 mu-clid tests pass; boundary PASS (136 mu-core files); mu-tant standalone smoke-tested (clean 4 s startup). Debug + Release clean at v1.0.673. | ✅ Closed | 673 |

Added a `textFromValueFunction` on the cutoff knob: integer **Hz** below 1 kHz, **kHz** to 2 dp above (e.g. `640 Hz`, `8.00 kHz`). Resonance knob also given a 2-dp formatter (was noisy on its 0..0.99 range). VoicePanel only; the formatters survive the per-voice attachment rebind since they live on the persistent slider object. Debug + Release clean at v1.0.672. | ✅ Closed | 672 |

Header band + Close button matching the mu-clid settings structure; more sections (content folder / MIDI) land with the features that need them. Debug + Release clean at v1.0.672. | ✅ Closed | 672 |

| 689 | **[mu-tant — play/stop transport + gate engine + gating timeline]** Implemented mu-tant's internal transport + wired the gate engine end-to-end. **Transport:** `PluginProcessor` overrides `isInternalPlaying` / `toggleInternalPlay` / `getInternalBpm` / `setInternalBpm` / `getInternalBeatPos` (the TransportBar play button now starts/stops; stop resets the beat to 0). The beat counter advances only while playing and wraps mod the 2-bar pattern (8 beats); modulators evaluate against the same wrapped position. **Gate engine:** `GatePattern::gateAt(beat)` evaluates the 0..1 gate — empty pattern → 1.0 (continuous drone); non-empty → the envelope owning the current cell drives the value, cells without an envelope are silent. `processBlock` applies the gate per-sample to each voice's post-filter output **only while playing** (stopped = gate held open so the oscillators stay auditionable), under a `GatePattern::editLock` tryLock so a concurrent UI edit can't tear the envelope vector. Per-cell envelope cache keeps the per-sample cost O(1). **Timeline + editing:** [GatingDesigner](mu-tant/Source/UI/GatingDesigner.h) draws a moving playhead synced to the song position (fed by a new 30 Hz [VoicePanel](mu-tant/Source/UI/VoicePanel.h) timer that also drives the modulator playhead), renders each envelope as a filled curve on the grid, and supports **pencil-click to add / eraser-click to remove** an envelope at the clicked cell (mutating under the editLock). New gate-engine unit tests (empty→open, envelope-cell-plays / empty-cell-silent, 2-bar wrap). 24/24 mu-tant tests + 140/140 mu-clid tests pass; boundary PASS; smoke-tested mu-tant launches cleanly. Debug + Release clean at v1.0.672. | ✅ Closed | 672 |

[mu-clid/CLAUDE.md](mu-clid/CLAUDE.md): replaced the leftover empty "Upcoming stages — _none scheduled_" stub table with a one-line "Work tracking" note pointing at the backlog. Docs-only. | ✅ Closed | 671 |

| 687 | **[mu-tant — envelope-grid toolbox: pencil / eraser / glue / reverse]** Added a 4-button toolbox to the [GatingDesigner](mu-tant/Source/UI/GatingDesigner.h) header (between the "Gating" title and the Grid subdivision dropdown). New `GateToolButton` vector-draws each icon procedurally (no asset dependency, scales with UI, stays in the mu palette): pencil (diagonal shaft + tip triangle), eraser (parallelogram block), glue (teardrop), reverse (two opposing arrows). Radio-grouped so exactly one tool is active; pencil default-selected. `GateTool` enum + `selectedTool()` accessor exposed. **Roles are placeholders** — selecting a tool only highlights it for now; the edit behaviours wire up when the drawable gate canvas lands. Smoke-tested: mu-tant launches cleanly. Debug + Release clean at v1.0.671. | ✅ Closed | 671 |

| 686 | **[mu-tant — voice param overhaul: pitch ranges, noise source, per-osc levels, filter resolution]** Reworked the per-voice synth params per the latest design pass. **Pitch (all integer-stepped):** Octave 0..8 → **-3..+3** (offset from base octave 4), Tone (0..14 scale-degree float) → **Semi -12..+12** (integer scale-degree offset — keeps the scale-quantised model; see note), Fine ±100 cents now integer-stepped (was 0.1). **Wavetable position:** 0..1 float → **0..255** integer frame index (256-frame Serum/Vital tables per design-voice.md; normalised to the osc's 0..1 scan in `setConfig`). **X-Mod:** 0..1 → **0..127** integer (normalised to the FM index in `process`). **Levels:** removed the single osc-balance `mix`; added independent **Osc1 Level / Osc2 Level / Noise Level** (dB) + a **White/Pink** noise-type toggle. New `NoiseGen` in [SynthVoice.h](mu-tant/Source/Audio/SynthVoice.h) (white = RNG, pink = Paul Kellet's economy 3-pole filter). **Filter:** cutoff range/skew now matches mu-clid exactly — `NormalisableRange(20, 20000, 0.0, 0.25)` continuous (was step 1.0 / setSkewForCentre 640). Updated the modulation-destination table ([MuTantModDest.h](mu-tant/Source/Modulation/MuTantModDest.h)) to match: osc1/osc2 semi (was tone), osc1.level/osc2.level/noise.level (was mix), grouped Osc 1 / Osc 2 / Mix / Levels / Filter / Amp. VoicePanel rebuilt the control set (Semi knobs, per-osc + noise level knobs, noise-type dropdown). processBlock seed/read-back + ModulatorTests required-keys updated to the new key set. **Note:** "Semi" steps scale degrees (the existing scale-quantised model), not raw chromatic semitones — flag if chromatic is wanted instead. 21/21 mu-tant tests + 140/140 mu-clid tests pass; boundary PASS; Debug + Release clean at v1.0.671. | ✅ Closed | 671 |

| 685 | **[mu-clid — Euclidean panel spacing: unify pad/insert knob gap + breathe the Steps/Hits/Rotate knobs]** The Pre/Post Pad knob pair and the Insert knob pair had mismatched horizontal spacing — Pad pair sat ~24 px apart, Insert pair sat a full column (~104 px) apart. Unified both to a single shared `kPadKnobGap = 48` (was 24 for pad only); the Insert pair now centres inside its sub-panel using the same `padPairW` geometry as the Pad pair, so the two pairs' spacing is identical (midway between the old too-close / too-far extremes). Widened `kEucKnobGap` 6 → 18 so Steps/Hits/Rotate breathe; because the Euclid block width feeds the derived `pW`, growing it also shrinks the Pad/Insert columns — satisfying "shrink those panels a bit" + "space the Euclid controls more" together. [EuclideanPanel.h](mu-clid/Source/UI/EuclideanPanel.h) constants + [EuclideanPanel.cpp](mu-clid/Source/UI/EuclideanPanel.cpp) insert-pair layout. Pure layout change; smoke-tested mu-clid launches cleanly. Debug + Release clean at v1.0.671. | ✅ Closed | 671 |

Switching voices in the sidebar now pulls the bound voice's persisted subdivision into the dropdown; turning the dropdown writes back to the bound pattern. nullptr unbinds (constructor default) — first-time voice selection is the first `setPattern` call. No test additions — the existing GatingDesignerTests still cover the subdivision-setter math; behaviour-only change. Smoke-tested: mu-tant launches cleanly. Debug + Release clean at v1.0.669. | ✅ Closed | 669 |

| 683 | **[Stage E — mu-tant `GatePattern` data model + per-voice storage + tests]** New [`mu_tant::GatePattern`](mu-tant/Source/Sequencer/GatePattern.h) — the data layer the drawable gate editor + audio-thread evaluator will both consume. `GatePattern` holds a flat `std::vector<GateEnvelope>` (cell + curveBend + options) plus a subdivision enum (Quarter / Eighth / Sixteenth / ThirtySecond). `GateEnvelope::value(phase01)` evaluates the envelope shape — linear decay at `curveBend=0`, concave (faster drop, audible gap) at negative bend, convex (sustains, late drop) at positive bend — via `pow(linearDecay, exponent)` with the bend mapped to `2^(-bend*2)`. `GateEnvelopeOptions` carries the design-spec gate-firing rules (reverse / probability / loopN/M / firstOnly / onStagedForChange). `PluginProcessor` gained `std::array<GatePattern, kMaxVoices> gatePatterns` (public, mutated under `voiceSlots[v].modLock`); the audio path doesn't yet apply the gate — that lands when `VoiceEngine` grows the gate stage between filter and insert. New [`GatePatternTests`](mu-tant/Source/Tests/GatePatternTests.cpp) covers: subdivision-to-cell-count math, linear decay endpoints, reverse polarity, concave/convex curve shaping, addOrReplaceEnvelope insert/replace/sort, removeEnvelopeAt no-op for absent cells, envelopeSpan to-next-envelope-or-pattern-end. Caught a curve-bend semantic inversion in the first pass — the tests forced the fix. 21/21 mu-tant tests pass (was 14: +6 GatePattern + 1 found-bug correction); 140/140 mu-clid tests pass; boundary PASS; Debug + Release clean at v1.0.668. | ✅ Closed | 668 |

Band Y/H positions tracked as member ints so `paint()` and `resized()` share one source of truth (mirrors mu-clid's `SettingsOverlay::LayoutY` pattern). The earlier flat row-of-knobs layout is gone — every knob's new home matches its design-doc band. mu-clid layout untouched. Smoke-tested locally — mu-tant launches cleanly. | ✅ Closed | 668 |

| 679 | **[mu-tant crash on startup — MixerOverlay null-derefs missing FX-rack APVTS params]** mu-Tant booted, played a short burst from the oscillators, then segfaulted before the editor window painted. Two ungauded `*proc.apvts.getRawParameterValue("eff_*")` / `"dly_*"` / `"rev_*"` / `"echo_*"` reads in [MixerOverlay](mu-core/UI/MixerOverlay.cpp) — one inside `wireFXRows()` at MixerOverlay construction (effect-param load block at line 278 onwards), one inside `loadFromAPVTS()` at line 486 onwards (full FX-rack reload). Both null-deref because mu-tant's first-stab APVTS deliberately omits the FX schema (Stage A3 ships the mixer with the FX rack inert by design). **Fix**: probe `apvts.getParameter("eff_p0") != nullptr` (constructor) and `apvts.getParameter("eff_en") != nullptr` (loadFromAPVTS) — when the FX rack isn't declared, skip the entire FX section. The rows still render with their default state; clicking them is a no-op (the lambda callbacks already use `if (auto* p = ...)` guards). Verified by launching mu-tant locally — UI renders without crash. mu-clid path is identical because its FX params all exist. 144/144 unit tests pass. Boundary check PASS. Debug + Release clean at v1.0.664. | ✅ Closed | 664 |

| 660 | **[Architecture — MIDI program-change path lifted from mu-clid into mu-core. New mu-family plugins (mu-tant, mu-toni) get the entire PC infrastructure for free.]** Pre-fix, mu-clid owned the FIFO + audio-thread scan + message-thread drain + the `MidiPresetMap` / `MidiFullPresetMap` storage classes + the `MidiPresetsPanel` / `MidiFullPresetsPanel` UI + the `PresetBrowser` overlay — even though every mu-family plugin will want the same channel-1-to-8 + channel-9 PC model. **Changes:** (1) [mu-core/Plugin/ProcessorBase.h](mu-core/Plugin/ProcessorBase.h) gained public `midiPresetMap` + `midiFullPresetMap` members, a private FIFO + queue, `scanMidiProgramChanges(midi)` (audio-thread) and `drainPendingMidiProgramChanges()` (message-thread), plus four pure-virtuals for the plugin-specific bits: `getPerSlotPresetDir/Extension()`, `getFullPresetDir/Extension()`, `applyMidiPresetSlot(int, juce::File)`, `applyFullMidiPreset(juce::File)`. (2) `MidiPresetMap` / `MidiFullPresetMap` lost their hard-coded `getDefaultFile()`; replaced with a `setStorageFile(juce::File)` that the consuming plugin calls once at startup before `load()`. (3) `MidiPresetsPanel` / `MidiFullPresetsPanel` / `PresetBrowser` all moved to [mu-core/UI/](mu-core/UI/); panels now take `ProcessorBase&` and read file-extension + browser-root from the new virtuals. Browser uses `MuLookAndFeel` directly (no mu-clid alias). (4) `mu-clid::PluginProcessor`: the maps + FIFO + queue + audio-scan + drain were all deleted (now on base); the four virtuals are tiny overrides — `stageRhythmPreset`, `loadPreset`, `getRhythmsDir`, `getPresetsDir`, "muRhyth", "muclid". (5) CMakeLists: mu-clid drops the five files; mu-core picks them up via its INTERFACE sources. **Files moved** (via `git mv`, history preserved): `Persistence/MidiPresetMap.{h,cpp}`, `Persistence/MidiFullPresetMap.{h,cpp}`, `UI/MidiPresetsPanel.{h,cpp}`, `UI/MidiFullPresetsPanel.{h,cpp}`, `UI/PresetBrowser.{h,cpp}`. **User-facing impact**: none — same JSON files at the same paths, same UI, same behaviour. **Layering rule held**: mu-core still has zero non-comment references to mu-clid types. 119/119 unit tests pass. Debug + Release built clean at v1.0.637. | ✅ Closed | 637 |

| 655 | **[MIDI program change → full `.muclid` preset on channel 9]** Extended the MIDI program-change handling: ch 1–8 → per-rhythm `.muRhyth` presets (unchanged, via `MidiPresetMap`), and **ch 9** → a full `.muclid` preset, deferred to the loop point via the full-preset hot-swap path (#653) when playing or applied immediately when stopped. **Storage**: new [MidiFullPresetMap](mu-clid/Source/Persistence/MidiFullPresetMap.h) — 128-entry array of `.muclid` paths persisted as JSON alongside the rhythm map (`%APPDATA%/TDP/muClid_midiFullPresets.json`), with an `enabled` flag so the audio path can early-out when the user hasn't opted in. **Audio path** ([mu-clid/Source/Plugin/PluginProcessor.cpp:323-363](mu-clid/Source/Plugin/PluginProcessor.cpp#L323-L363)): one unified loop drains PCs into the lock-free `pcQueue`, branching on channel — ch 1–8 gated by the existing `chMask`, ch 9 gated by `midiFullPresetMap.isEnabled()`. `ProgramChangeEvent` gained an `isFull` flag. **Message-thread drain** ([mu-clid/Source/Plugin/PluginProcessor.cpp:1052-1068](mu-clid/Source/Plugin/PluginProcessor.cpp#L1052-L1068)): when `fullPreset` is set, calls `loadPreset(f)` (defers via the staged hot-swap path when playing; applies immediately when stopped — same semantics as picking from the dropdown). **UI**: new [MidiFullPresetsPanel](mu-clid/Source/UI/MidiFullPresetsPanel.h) — 128-row editor parallel to `MidiPresetsPanel`, opened by the Settings "Main Preset Table" button (relabelled in #656). **Coverage**: works in any MIDI-receiving format — VST3, CLAP, Standalone (the path runs in `processBlock` so the wrapper is irrelevant). | ✅ Closed | 636 |

| 654 | **[Installer + build broke on the `µ` (U+03BC) product name → ASCII files, µ display]** `PRODUCT_NAME "µ-Clid"` named the artefacts `µ-Clid.*`; the non-ASCII filename broke the MSVC linker (LNK4232), Inno Setup (saw `Á-Clid.clap`) and the deploy copy under Windows codepage 1252. Fix: split the names — `PRODUCT_NAME "mu-Clid"` (ASCII files/bundles) + `PLUGIN_NAME "µ-Clid"` (the DAW display name, via `JucePlugin_Name`); added `/utf-8` to the MSVC flags so the µ in the `-D` define survives into the binary instead of mangling to `?` (also clears the C4566 warnings). Verified: ASCII `mu-Clid.*` artefacts + `µ-Clid` display name confirmed in the CLAP binary. Updated both `installer/*.iss` + the 4 `cmake/{Deploy,BuildInstaller}*.cmake` helpers to ASCII file names (installer UI text is ASCII; the DAW — the branding surface — keeps µ). Installer-build itself not re-verified here (needs Inno Setup). | ✅ Closed | 629 |

| 653 | **[Full-preset hot-swap defers to the loop point — prestage + tail-out]** Loading a full `.muclid` preset while the sequencer is playing now stages the swap and commits it at the next loop point instead of applying instantly (matching per-rhythm hot-swap). **Prestage**: all voices/samples/rhythms are built off the audio thread at load time (`PresetIO::buildPreparedFullPreset` → `HotSwapStager::PreparedFullPreset`); the commit is just fast in-memory moves under one `suspendProcessing` (`commitStagedFullPreset`), so no disk I/O at the boundary. **Tail-out**: outgoing voices are retired (retire-then-swap, same machinery as the per-rhythm path) so they ring out their sample/amp-env tail across the boundary rather than hard-cutting; slots a smaller preset drops are cut. **Loop point**: waits for the master loop when one is defined (`mstrLoop>0`), else falls back to rhythm 0's loop — fixes a hang where a free-running swap waited for a master loop that never wraps. **UI**: new `onPresetSwapCommitted` callback refreshes rhythm tabs / sidebar / mixer after a deferred commit; cleared in the editor dtor (UAF guard). Stopped-state loads + headless render still apply immediately. **Test harness**: `RenderMode` gains `--swap-preset`/`--swap-at` to drive a real mid-render swap (serviced via new `flushPendingAsyncUpdates`); new `TS_swap` listening test (`tests/presets/TS1.muclid` kick → empty `TS2.muclid`) asserts loop-point commit + tail-out + post-tail silence in a single render; legacy T11–T13 presets migrated into `tests/presets/` (repo-canonical) and the runner now resolves repo-local + content paths. Files: `HotSwapStager.{h,cpp}`, `PresetIO.{h,cpp}`, `PluginProcessor.h`, `PluginEditor.cpp`, `RenderMode.{h,cpp}`, `tests/`. | ✅ Closed | 626 |

| 651 | **[Architecture — mu-core fully layering-clean. MixerOverlay refactored to take `ProcessorBase&` + virtual channel-info methods; RenderMode moved out of mu-core back to mu-clid where it belongs]** Follow-up to #650 — auditing the remaining mu-core files for direct dependencies on mu-clid types surfaced two: (1) `mu-core/UI/MixerOverlay.h` still took `PluginProcessor&` + reached for `proc.getNumRhythms()` / `proc.getRhythm(r).name` / `proc.getRhythm(r).colourIndex`; (2) `mu-core/Plugin/RenderMode.{h,cpp}` constructed `PluginProcessor` directly + called mu-clid-specific methods (`applyRhythmPreset`, `loadPreset`, `toggleInternalPlay`, `skipAutoLoadDefault`). **Fix (1)**: added three pure-virtual methods to [mu-core/Plugin/ProcessorBase.h:46-53](mu-core/Plugin/ProcessorBase.h#L46-L53) — `getNumChannels()`, `getChannelName(int)`, `getChannelColourIndex(int)` — covering the abstract "this plugin has N channels with names and palette colours" contract. MixerOverlay now takes `ProcessorBase&` ([mu-core/UI/MixerOverlay.h](mu-core/UI/MixerOverlay.h)) and uses the channel-info API instead of reaching for Rhythm directly. **Fix (2)**: `git mv mu-core/Plugin/RenderMode.{h,cpp} → mu-clid/Source/Plugin/RenderMode.{h,cpp}`. The render entry point is genuinely plugin-specific (each plugin has its own preset format + transport semantics); mu-tant will own its own RenderMode when it arrives. `mu-clid/CMakeLists.txt` updated to reference the new path; `mu-core/Plugin/` now contains only `ProcessorBase.{h,cpp}` (just the shared base, as it should be). **Audit confirmation**: `grep -r '\bPluginProcessor\b' mu-core/` after the refactor returns only COMMENT references — every executable code path in mu-core is now plugin-agnostic. **Mu-tant impact**: a sibling plugin can now `target_link_libraries(mu-tant PRIVATE mu-core)` and pull in MixerOverlay + MixerChannel + FXRow + DelayRow + RenderMode-equivalent without touching mu-clid headers. Layering rule from #650 ("mu-core may never include Plugin/PluginProcessor.h") is now genuinely enforced rather than aspirational. 119/119 C++ tests pass; 3/3 listening tests pass; Debug + Release built clean at v1.0.616. | ✅ Closed | 616 |

| 650 | **[Architecture — `mu-core::ProcessorBase` now owns `apvts`; mu-core UI components (MixerChannel) take `ProcessorBase*` instead of mu-clid's `PluginProcessor*`; layering violation cleared]** Pre-fix mu-core's MixerChannel*.cpp included [mu-clid's Plugin/PluginProcessor.h](mu-clid/Source/Plugin/PluginProcessor.h) — a downward dependency that would have blocked mu-tant / mu-toni from reusing the mixer UI. | 649 | **[Feature — Listening-test pipeline. Render-to-WAV + Python analysis automates the T11/T12/T13-style audio regressions]** End-to-end loop: write a test preset → standalone renders it headlessly → Python script measures the audio → assertions either pass or fail. Replaces "Andy listens and reports" for the objective parts of every listening test; the genuinely subjective bits ("feels musical") still need ears. Designed cross-plugin so mu-tant + mu-toni get the same harness when extracted. **Pieces shipped**: (1) [Source/Plugin/RenderMode.{h,cpp}](Source/Plugin/RenderMode.h) — headless CLI mode triggered by `--render --out <wav> --preset <path> --seconds N`. Bypasses GUI window + audio device, calls `processBlock` in a tight loop, writes 24-bit stereo WAV via `juce::WavAudioFormat`. Wired into [Source/Plugin/StandaloneApp.cpp:105-120](Source/Plugin/StandaloneApp.cpp#L105-L120) so any `--render` invocation skips normal startup. (2) `PluginProcessor::skipAutoLoadDefault` static flag ([Source/Plugin/PluginProcessor.h:225-230](Source/Plugin/PluginProcessor.h#L225-L230)) so render mode bypasses the ctor's `_default.muclid` auto-load — every test starts from a clean single-rhythm state. (3) [Source/Plugin/PresetIO.cpp:817-831](Source/Plugin/PresetIO.cpp#L817-L831) `loadDefaultPreset()` extended to fall back to `_default.muRhyth` when no `_default.muclid` is present, so the GUI auto-loads whatever test preset is currently being iterated on without a click. (4) [tests/scripts/analyse.py](tests/scripts/analyse.py) — pure-Python analyser using numpy + scipy. Four metrics: `peak_dbfs`, `rms_dbfs`, `duration_above_threshold`, `spectral_peak_near` (FFT via scipy.signal.welch). Per-test JSON spec + named assertions; exits 0 / 1 / 2 for pass / fail / error. (5) [tests/expectations/T11.json](tests/expectations/T11.json), `T12.json`, `T13.json` — each ~4 assertions tied to the test's intent (e.g. T12's `karplus_tail_past_env_idle` checks RMS at t=1.4s is above -45 dBFS, confirming the post-env-idle ringing introduced in #646). (6) [tests/scripts/run-listening-tests.py](tests/scripts/run-listening-tests.py) — orchestrator: walks `tests/expectations/*.json`, runs each via the standalone, runs analyse.py, prints per-test summary, exits non-zero on any failure. (7) [tests/README.md](tests/README.md) — full docs covering the layout, render flags, JSON schema, channels, metric catalogue, and a 7-step "adding a new test" recipe.
