| 297 | Defensive — `MixerEngine::processBlock` now clears `sidechainGR[r]` for inactive channel slots (sibling of #188/#296). Previously only `channelPeaks` was cleared for `r >= numActiveRhythms`, so removed rhythms could leave a stale GR reading on their now-inactive UI slot. `sidechainGR[r]` is now cleared in the same loop. | ✅ Closed | 321 |

| 296 | Mixer GR meter — clearing repaint not triggered when fill decayed below threshold (sibling of #188/#297). `timerCallback`'s repaint trigger compared only `abs(displayGR - prev) > 0.001f`, which suppressed the final repaint when `displayGR` decayed below the drawing threshold — leaving a small ghost fill on screen. Fixed by also forcing a repaint whenever the visibility state flips (was visible → now invisible, or vice versa). | ✅ Closed | 321 |

| 295 | Sidebar drag-reorder — sidechain source indices not re-translated (sibling of #190). Sidechain source stored slot indices (0–7) that did not follow the rhythm after a reorder — a channel sidechaining from "Kick at slot 0" would still point at slot 0 after Kick moved to slot 2, sourcing the wrong channel. Fixed by re-translating every channel's `sidechainSource` in `swapRhythms` BEFORE the channel swap: any channel pointing at `i` now points at `j`, and vice versa. Also: `swapAPVTSForRhythms` now pushes EVERY active channel (not just `i` and `j`) because the re-translation can touch channels outside the swapped pair. Defensive: `scEnv[i]/scEnv[j]` reset to 0 via new `MixerEngine::resetSidechainEnv(int)` helper so the previous tenant's ducking envelope cannot bleed into the freshly arrived rhythm. | ✅ Closed | 324 |

| 294 | Preset save audited — already covers all mixer-page state correctly (sibling of #193/#292/#293). Verified per-channel state lives in each `Rhythm` subtree, FX/returns/master/master-insert lives in `GlobalState`, and the round-trip on load is exact. No code change — verification only. | ✅ Closed | 328 |

| 293 | Missing linked samples now show a clear visual indicator with a click-to-find affordance (sibling of #193/#292/#294). Previously, when a preset's linked sample could not be found at its recorded path or in the user Samples folder, the loader silently skipped `loadFile` — leaving the slot either empty or with the previous tenant's sample still loaded. New behaviour: `voiceEngines[i]->clearSample()` is called on miss (new public `VoiceEngine::clearSample` method that safely zeroes the buffer under the existing `bufferLock`), and the path is preserved in `loadedSamplePaths[i]`. New helper `PluginProcessor::isSampleMissing(int)` returns true when a path is recorded but the voice has no actual sample. `RhythmPanel::paint` reads this and renders the sample bar in amber with "Missing: filename.wav — click to find" — the existing mouseDown-on-sample-bar handler already routes through `loadSample()` so the user clicks once to relocate. | ✅ Closed | 328 |

| 292 | Preset shrink now wipes stale mixer state on the removed slots (sibling of #193/#293/#294). When loading a preset with fewer rhythms than currently active, `loadPreset` already reset `voiceEngines[i]` and `midiEngines[i]` for the now-inactive slots — but `mixerEngine.channels[i]` and `loadedSamplePaths[i]` retained their pre-load values, so opening the mixer would show ghost faders/sidechain settings on the dimmed slots. Both are now reset to defaults alongside the voice/midi engines. | ✅ Closed | 328 |

| 291 | Filter cutoff modulation now multiplicative in octaves, not additive in Hz (sibling of #216/#289/#290). `ModulationMatrix::depthScaleFor("filter.cutoff")` and `depthScaleFor("insert.lpf")` changed from 8000 (Hz) to 48 (semitones, =±4 octaves) — matching `filterEnvDepth`. New `isLogHzDest()` helper drives the apply step: `dst *= 2^(amount / 12.0f)` for Hz destinations, additive for everything else. Same depth now sweeps the same number of octaves whether the base cutoff is 100 Hz or 10 kHz. **Preset-feel change** for any existing patch using cutoff modulation, but no API/format break. Code references this as `// #216 #4` and now should be read as `// #291`. | ✅ Closed | 335 |

| 290 | Stale ADSR mapping comment corrected (sibling of #216/#289/#291). `VoiceSection.cpp:55` comment said "0→1 ms, 100→10 s" but the actual `adsrTime(v) = max(0.001, v * 0.03)` mapping was "0→1 ms, 100→3 s". Comment updated to match — no code/behaviour change. (Note: this comment is now historical — superseded by the seconds-domain flip in #217/#286/#287.) | ✅ Closed | 335 |

| 289 | Drive tone knob log-skewed for every full-range mode (sibling of #216/#290/#291). `setSkewFactorFromMidPoint(640.0)` applied in `VoiceSection` ctor + the Soft/Hard/Fold, Bitcrusher, and Clipper LPF cases. Same change applied to `MixerChannel` master insert (ctor + Soft/Hard/Fold/Clipper case). Modes with their own ranges (3-Band EQ Mid Hz, Compressor Release, Ring Mod Freq, Tape Sat Tone) keep their existing per-case skew. | ✅ Closed | 335 |

| 288 | Legacy host-state migration for the #217/#286/#287 ADSR unit flip. Completes the cherry-pick recovery batch. Without this, a Bitwig (or any DAW) session saved before #217/#286/#287 would reload with the old 0..100 attack/decay/release values clamped to the new 0..10 s max — a previously-tuned 30/100 (0.9s) attack would become a 10s attack (or 30s if no clamp). Fix: new `kCurrentStateFormatVersion = 2` constant at the top of `PluginProcessor.cpp`. `populateStateTree` writes `formatVersion` as a property on the state root. New `migrateLegacyHostState(ValueTree&)` helper iterates `<PARAM>` children, identifies ADSR-time IDs (`r{N}_(aEnvAtk\|Dec\|Rel\|fEnvAtk\|Dec\|Rel\|pEnvAtk\|Dec\|Rel)`), multiplies their value by 0.03 (the old display→seconds factor) and clamps to 0..10. Special case for `aEnvRel`: old value >= 100 (End-mode sentinel) maps to new value 10 (new End-mode sentinel) so "play to natural end" patches round-trip correctly. The migration helper is called from `restoreStateFromTree` on a `state.createCopy()` so the original tree is untouched. Final step writes `formatVersion = 2` so re-loading a migrated state is a no-op. `.muclid` / `.muRhyth` preset files are out of scope (no presets saved yet); follow-up if needed once presets exist. | ✅ Closed | 345 |

| 287 | Pitch envelope time params (`pEnvAtk` / `pEnvDec` / `pEnvRel`) migrated from `0..100` linear → `0..10 seconds` with skew 0.3 — completes the ADSR unit-flip trio after #217 (amp) and #286 (filter). APVTS layout for the three params switched from `addF(..., 0, 100, …)` to `addAdsrT(...)` so DAW automation lanes show "X ms" / "X.XX s" with knob centre at ~100–200 ms. `applyRhythmSuffix` writes seconds directly via `juce::jmax(0.001f, v)` instead of `adsrTime(v)`; `pushRhythmToAPVTS` writes seconds directly (no `* (100/3)`). VoiceSection: pitchAtk/Dec/Rel ranges flipped to `(0, 10, 0.001)` with `setSkewFactor(0.3)`; pitch knobs merged into the unified seconds-domain formatter loop alongside amp + filter (legacy `formatAdsrTime` / `parseAdsrTime` helpers now unused but retained for one release as a safety net); `loadFromRhythm` strips the `* (100/3)` conversion. Default knob values rounded at the boundary: 0.0 → 0.0 s (was 0/100), 1.0 → 0.03 s (was 1/100 = ~30 ms with old mapping). Sustain stays 0..100 %. No pitch envelope destinations exist in the modulation system, so no snapshot/apply round-trip changes needed (only `pitch.envDepth` is modulatable, which is already in semitones). All three voice envelopes (pitch, filter, amp) now share the same 0..10 s seconds-domain shape — UI looks consistent. **Preset compat**: legacy host-state pEnvAtk/Dec/Rel values stored in 0..100 will clamp to 10 (new max) when loaded — same caveat as #217/#286, fix deferred to #288. | ✅ Closed | 344 |

| 286 | Filter envelope time params (`fEnvAtk` / `fEnvDec` / `fEnvRel`) migrated from `0..100` linear → `0..10 seconds` with skew 0.3 — same shape as the amp envelope (#217). APVTS layout for the three params switched from `addF(..., 0, 100, …)` to `addAdsrT(...)` so DAW automation lanes show "X ms" / "X.XX s" and the slider centre lands at ~100–200 ms. `applyRhythmSuffix` writes seconds directly via `juce::jmax(0.001f, v)` instead of `adsrTime(v) = v * 0.03`. `pushRhythmToAPVTS` writes seconds directly (no `* (100/3)` factor). VoiceSection: filterAtk/Dec/Rel ranges flipped to `(0, 10, 0.001)` with `setSkewFactor(0.3)`; formatters moved from the legacy `formatAdsrTime` (0..100 → 0..3 s) loop to the seconds-domain `formatAdsrTimeSec` loop; `loadFromRhythm` strips the `* (100/3)` conversion. Defaults rounded to legacy equivalents at the boundary: 1.0 → 0.03 s, 3.0 → 0.09 s — typical short filter sweeps still feel instant. Sustain stays 0..100 %. Modulation snapshot/apply round-trip (`fenv.attack` / `fenv.decay` keys) keeps its `* (100/3)` / `* 0.03` scaling because the mod system internally works in 0..100 territory — same pattern as #217. Pitch envelope remains on legacy mapping pending #287. | ✅ Closed | 341 |

| 285 | Mixer Effect FX dropdown listener-skip on unchanged value (HIGH, user-visible — sibling of #242). When the user picked the same algorithm a saved host state already had (e.g. Phaser → Phaser after a reload), `setValueNotifyingHost(eff_algo, idx)` was called with the same value APVTS already held, so JUCE skipped the listener callback and `syncFXParam` never fired. Engine stayed at the default `0 = Chorus`. Then `loadFromAPVTS` read `eff.getAlgorithmIndex() = 0` and called `setSelectedAlgorithm(0)`, snapping the FXRow dropdown back to Chorus on every knob touch. Fix: `MixerOverlay::wireFXRows`'s effectRow `onAlgorithmChanged` now calls `eff.setAlgorithm(idx)` **before** `setValueNotifyingHost`, so the engine updates even when the APVTS write is a no-op. `loadFromAPVTS` now reads `eff_algo` from APVTS (source of truth) instead of the engine, and force-resyncs the engine if it diverges. Combined with #242, dropdown changes persist correctly across knob touches and host-state restores. | ✅ Closed | 342 |

| 284 | 3-Band EQ master-insert Low/High knob default rest position aligned with Mid (sibling of #244). Mirrored the #147 reset-on-algorithm-switch fix to `MixerChannel::insCharBox.onChange`: entering EQ (newChar==6) resets `mst_insDrv` / `mst_insDit` to 50 (=0 dB visual centre) and `mst_insMid` to 0 (already direct), so Low/Mid/High all start at 0 dB. Leaving EQ resets `mst_insDrv` / `mst_insDit` back to 0 so distortion-mode defaults (drive=0) are sane. All three EQ knobs now have a consistent rest position at slider centre instead of two-at-the-bottom-one-in-the-middle. | ✅ Closed | 346 |

| 283 | Second master insert — add a second insert slot to the master channel strip in the Mixer, chained in series after the existing insert (Insert 1 → Insert 2 → master output). Each slot has its own algorithm dropdown and Drive/Output/Dither/Tone knobs, enabling e.g. EQ into a limiter or saturation into a compressor on the master bus. `kInsertPanelW` widened from 130 to 260 px; `configureInsertAlgorithm` gains a `slot` param to share all 11 switch cases between both slots; 8 new APVTS params `mst_ins2*`; `MixerEngine` gains `masterInsertParams2` + `masterInsert2` chained after insert 1 in `processBlock`. | ✅ Closed | 389 |

| 282 | Preset browser category filtering — rhythm-preset browser (.muRhyth) gains a category filter dropdown matching the existing full-preset browser; both browsers read from and write to a shared `categories.txt` in the content folder. `RhythmPresetBrowser` gains `DropdownSelect categoryFilter`, per-file category metadata parsed from preset XML, and `applyFilter()` honouring both search text and category. `RhythmSaveDialog` gains `DropdownSelect categoryDropdown` + new-category text field; `onSave` callback extended to `(name, category, embed)`. New `PluginProcessor::loadCategoryList()` and `ensureCategoryInList()` maintain the shared list; `PluginEditor::showSaveDialog` merges categories from all three sources. | ✅ Closed | 389 |

| 281 | Accent ring visual jumps back to start when combined A+B pattern wraps — `rotAngleC` was computed as `(currentStep % stepsC)` where `currentStep = effectiveStep % patLen`. When `patLen` (LCM of A+B steps) is not a multiple of `stepsC`, the combined-pattern wrap resets `currentStep` to 0, snapping the accent ring to position 0 mid-cycle. Fixed by tracking `effectiveStep % stepsC` independently in `SequencerEngine::lastAccentStepIndex[r]`, exposed via `getLastAccentStepIndex()`, stored as `RhythmPlayState::currentStepC`, and used directly in `RhythmCircle` without further modulo. | ✅ Closed | 385 |

| 280 | First-play audio delay — standalone played for ~500 ms before any sound was heard on the very first play after launch. Root cause was a combination of (a) JUCE standalone's WASAPI device init (~200-300 ms — inherent to the JUCE wrapper, not our code) and (b) the sequencer absorbing step 0 of the default rhythm on the very first `processBlock`, pushing the first audible hit to step 1 (~125-250 ms depending on BPM). The audible component is fully addressed by [[#384]]: cold-start and standalone restart-from-zero now fire step 0 inside the first audio block. The residual WASAPI device-init delay is JUCE-side and out of scope. | ✅ Closed | 451 |

| 279 | Filter type dropdown too narrow to show long labels (e.g. "Notch 24") — filter section had 5 columns but only used 4 for knobs, leaving one empty. Fixed: `filterType` dropdown widened from 1×kW to 2×kW, using the previously empty column. Filter knobs (Cutoff, Res, Depth) shifted right by 1 column (cols 2–4); ADSR row (Atk, Dec, Sus, Rel) shifted right by 1 (cols 1–4). | ✅ Closed | 381 |

| 278 | Modulator timing defaults — loop default was "1/4 × 4" (= 1 bar but confusingly expressed); step default was "1/4 × 1" (too coarse). Changed `ControlSequence` defaults: `loopNoteValue = Whole, loopMultiplier = 1` so the display shows "1 × 1" (one bar, unambiguous); `stepNoteValue = Sixteenth, stepMultiplier = 1` so the step grid starts at 1/16. Also updated `loopMult` NudgeInput default-value arg from 4 to 1 in `ModulatorEditor.h`. | ✅ Closed | 381 |

| 277 | NudgeInput inline multiplier shows only "×" with no number — `inlineLblW = 26` reserved 26 px for the label inside the `displayBounds` of width 30 px, leaving only 4 px for the value digit: invisible at any reasonable font. Reduced `inlineLblW` from 26 to 14 in `NudgeInput.cpp` so "×" (14 px) and the value number (16 px) both render. | ✅ Closed | 381 |

| 276 | Assignment rows not numbered in ModulatorEditor — when multiple targets are listed, duplicate destination names give no indication of order. Added `int rowNumber = 0` field to `AssignmentRow`; `rebuildRows()` sets it to 1-based insertion index; `paint()` draws the number + "." in a 20 px gutter at the left edge; `resized()` adjusted `destW` to account for the gutter. | ✅ Closed | 381 |

| 275 | Permanent modulation ring when sequencer stopped — `refreshModulatedIndicators()` called `setIsModulated(true)` for any knob with an assignment regardless of playback state, drawing a permanent cyan ring around the knob. Extended the `playing` gate (introduced in #272 for the live arc) to cover `setIsModulated()` calls as well — all calls now pass `playing && isAssigned("...")`. Also fixed `driveDrive.setModulatedNorm()` which was using `sn()` directly instead of the `arc()` lambda, causing the drive knob's live arc to persist after stopping. | ✅ Closed | 380 |

| 274 | Modulator assignment rows invisible after adding a target — `ModulatorEditor::resized()` computed `viewH = h - editorBottom - kPagerH - kAddBtnH - 4` where `editorBottom = kHeaderH(28) + kEditorH(150) + 4 = 182`, requiring `h > 234` for any visible rows. `RhythmPanel::resized()` used a stale `minModH = 258` calibrated for the old layout (kEditorH=100 + 2 timing rows of 28). Updated `minModH` from 258 to 332 so the modulator panel is always allocated enough height for at least 2 visible assignment rows at the default 870 px window height: `tab(28) + header(28) + editor(150) + 4 + pager(20) + 4 + addBtn(28) + 2 rows(56) + reduce(14) = 332`. | ✅ Closed | 380 |

| 273 | Modulation knob top clipping — `KnobWithLabel::resized()` placed the rotary slider at y=0 within the component; the modulation ring (drawn at `radius+2` in `paintOverChildren`) and live arc (at `radius+4`) extended above y=0, clipping against the component boundary. Fixed by adding `topPad=4` so the slider starts at y=4, giving the ring and arc room to draw without clipping. `paint()` and `showInlineEditor()` updated to use the same offset for value text and inline editor positioning. | ✅ Closed | 379 |

| 272 | Modulation live arc visible when sequencer is stopped — `refreshModulatedIndicators()` called `setModulatedNorm()` with the last audio-thread snapshot value regardless of playback state. When stopped the snapshot holds the final modulated position, causing the blue arc to show permanently. Fixed in `VoiceSection::refreshModulatedIndicators()`: the `arc()` lambda now returns `kNaN` (disabling the arc) when `proc.sequencerPlaying.get()` is false. The static "is modulated" ring was intentionally left showing at this stage; the permanent-ring fix was completed in #275. | ✅ Closed | 379 |

| 271 | Modulator editor Loop/Step timing controls moved to header row — Loop note-value dropdown and multiplier, plus Step note-value dropdown and multiplier (Stepped mode only), are now positioned on the same row as the Mod name, Smooth/Stepped dropdown, and Uni/Bi polarity control. Saves 28–56 px of vertical space. `kEditorH` increased from 100 to 150 px so the LFO/step editor curve has more room. Step count text moved to far-right of the header row. | ✅ Closed | 377 |

| 270 | ModMatrixPanel and ModulatorEditor assignment navigation — (1) **ModMatrixPanel pager**: ▲/▼ buttons in the header right-side + page counter appear when assignments exceed what fits on screen; current page number shown as "X / Y". Count label shows "N assignments" when all fit. (2) **ModulatorEditor pager**: same ▲/▼ + counter above the Add Target button; scrolls the viewport one row at a time; shows "N–M / T" range when multi-page, "N targets" when single page. (3) **Matrix refresh on tab switch**: switching to the Matrix tab now calls `matrixPanel.refresh()` so newly added assignments are visible immediately. (4) **"Mod 65" garbage**: `juce::String(char(...))` replaced with `juce::String::charToString(...)` in popup menu and row source label. (5) **Em dash garbage**: `u8"..."` literal replaced with explicit `\xe2\x80\x94` hex escape. (6) **Hint text/button overlap**: empty-state hint text repositioned below the pager row, add button fixed to panel bottom. | ✅ Closed | 377 |

| 269 | Crash on modulation assignment delete — `onRemove` in `ModulatorEditor::rebuildRows()` and `ModMatrixPanel::rebuildRows()` called `rebuildRows()` synchronously from within a `TextButton::onClick` lambda, which destroyed the `AssignmentRow`/`MatrixRow` containing the clicked button before JUCE's button machinery could return cleanly. Fixed by deferring `rebuildRows()` in both files using `juce::MessageManager::callAsync()` + `juce::Component::SafePointer` so destruction happens after the event handler unwinds. Also applied to `onDestChange` in `ModMatrixPanel` which had the same pattern. | ✅ Closed | 375 |

| 268 | Rhythm preset dropdown refinements: (1) **Garbage characters** — placeholder `…` and em dash in save dialog "File exists" message fixed via `juce::String::fromUTF8()`. (2) **Dropdown size** — width is now dynamic; left edge aligns with the main preset dropdown in the TransportBar + 10 px indent (PluginEditor passes `transportBar.getPresetDropdownLeft()` to `rhythmPanel.setPresetDropLeft()` after layout; falls back to 200 px if not yet set). (3) **Save behavior** — if a preset is currently loaded in the dropdown, Save shows an AlertWindow "Overwrite / Save As… / Cancel" instead of the Save As dialog; if none is loaded, Save As dialog opens as before. After save-as, `loadedRhythmPresetFile` is updated and the dropdown re-selects the newly saved preset. Alert "Save As…" option clears the loaded file and re-opens the dialog. | ✅ Closed | 373 |

| 267 | Rhythm preset dropdown — replace the "Load" button in the `RhythmPanel` header with a `DropdownSelect` matching the main preset dropdown style (same `DropdownSelect` component, same visual language). Dropdown lists `.muRhyth` files from the rhythms folder, sorted alphabetically. Selecting an item loads the preset immediately via `proc.stageRhythmPreset`. Placeholder text "rhythm preset…". Dropdown refreshes on `setRhythm()` and after saving a new preset so newly saved files appear immediately. The existing `RhythmPresetBrowser` modal overlay remains in the codebase but is no longer exposed via a button. | ✅ Closed | 371 |

| 266 | Fix `insert.bits` modulation depth scale — `depthScaleFor("insert.bits")` returned 16.0f, meaning at full depth (100%) and full CS output (100%), bit depth shifted by ±16 (the entire 1–16 range). User reported that anything outside ±1 bit of shift is unusable. Scale reduced to 1.0f so full depth/CS gives ±1 bit. Reference table added as a comment block above `depthScaleFor()` in `ModulationMatrix.cpp` documenting all destinations with their units, range, scale, and rationale. | ✅ Closed | 371 |

| 265 | Rhythm preset browser — inline `RhythmPresetBrowser` overlay replaces the OS native file picker for loading rhythm presets. Card-modal sits over the `RhythmPanel` content; accent colour matches the current rhythm colour (header band + border + selection highlight) to visually distinguish rhythm-level presets from plugin-level presets. Lists `.muRhyth` files from the rhythms folder with a search box; double-click or Load button loads; right-click offers Load/Delete; click-outside or Cancel dismisses. | ✅ Closed | 370 |

| 264 | Insert effect per-algorithm state snapshots for A/B-ing. `InsertAlgoSnapshot` struct (7 float fields matching VoiceParams) added to both `MixerChannel` and `VoiceSection`. `kInsertDefaults[11]` table defines sensible first-visit defaults per algorithm (e.g. Clipper=100% threshold, EQ=0 dB all bands/1 kHz, Comp=−12 dB/200 ms release, Ring Mod=50% mix/440 Hz). On algorithm switch: outgoing params are saved to `insertSnapshots[oldChar]`, incoming are restored from `insertSnapshots[newChar]` (or defaults on first visit). This replaces all previous special-case EQ/Clipper/Comp reset code with a unified save-and-restore. Per-voice snapshots reset in `setRhythm()` so each rhythm starts with a clean A/B state. | ✅ Closed | 364 |

| 263 | Insert effect volume discrepancy on algorithm change. Three root causes: (1) **Clipper silence bug** — `thresh = driveDrive/100`, so default `driveDrive=0` clamps to ±0.001 (≈ −60 dB). Fixed by resetting `drvDrv`/`mst_insDrv` to 100% whenever entering Clipper from any other algorithm. (2) **EQ→distortion drive bleed (per-voice)** — `driveChar.onChange` was resetting `drvDrv=50` when leaving EQ; for distortion algorithms 50% = 20 dB pre-gain. Fixed to reset to 0. (3) **Comp/Limiter output bleed** — `mst_insOut`/`drvOut` range is −24..+24 dB for makeup gain; switching away without reset left positive gain on the next algorithm. Fixed by resetting output to 0 dB when leaving Comp/Limiter. Changes in `MixerChannel.cpp` (`bindMaster` `insCharBox.onChange`) and `VoiceSection.cpp` (`driveChar.onChange`). | ✅ Closed | 363 |

| 262 | Master insert EQ panel: knobs now single-column (High / Mid Gain / Mid Hz / Low, top to bottom) instead of 2-column grid; `MixerChannel::resized()` branches on `insCharBox.getSelectedId() == 7` for the single-column path. Compressor/Limiter Output knob extended to −24..+24 dB (was −24..0) in both `MixerChannel` and `VoiceSection`; APVTS params `drvOut` and `mst_insOut` ranges updated to match; modulation matrix `jlimit` for `insert.output` updated to 24.0f. | ✅ Closed | 362 |

| 261 | Rename `MuClidLookAndFeel` → `MuLookAndFeel` (+ backward-compat shim). New `MuLookAndFeel.h/.cpp` holds the class; `MuClidLookAndFeel.h` becomes `#include "MuLookAndFeel.h"\n using MuClidLookAndFeel = MuLookAndFeel;` so all 58 existing include sites compile unchanged. `MuClidLookAndFeel.cpp` emptied; CMakeLists updated to compile `MuLookAndFeel.cpp` instead. Part of Stage 33. | ✅ Closed | 368 |

| 260 | `ProcessorBase` shared base class — extends `juce::AudioProcessor`, holds `fxChain` and `mixerEngine` (public), and provides `processCoreBlock()` that calls `fxChain.setHostBpm()` + `mixerEngine.processBlock()`. `PluginProcessor` now extends `ProcessorBase` instead of `AudioProcessor` directly; calls `processCoreBlock()` from its `processBlock()` after sequencer/modulation work. mu-tant's future processor will extend the same base. Part of Stage 33. | ✅ Closed | 368 |

| 259 | `VoiceSlot` base struct extracted from `Rhythm`. Non-Euclidean members (`VoiceParams`, `controlSequences`, `ModulationMatrix`, `modLock`, `name`, `colourIndex`, `MaxControlSequences`) moved to `Source/Sequencer/VoiceSlot.h`. `Rhythm` extends `VoiceSlot` and adds `genA/B/C`, `logic`, `resetSteps`. Copy constructor and assignment operator chain through `VoiceSlot`. mu-tant voice types will extend `VoiceSlot` directly. Part of Stage 33. | ✅ Closed | 368 |

| 258 | `mu-core` CMake INTERFACE library — shared audio/FX/modulation/UI source files listed once in a CMake `INTERFACE` target. Both `mu-clid` and `mu-clid-lite` link against it, eliminating previous source duplication. Uses INTERFACE (not STATIC) so shared sources compile in each consuming plugin target's JUCE-initialised context, avoiding JUCE module duplication. Also removes `MuClidLookAndFeel.cpp` from both targets (replaced by `MuLookAndFeel.cpp` via mu-core). Part of Stage 33. | ✅ Closed | 368 |

| 257 | FX section + FXRow scaling. (1) FX area height: `kFXAreaH` and `kFXRowH` removed as static constants; `fxAreaH = jmax(220, round(h * 0.32f))` and `fxRowH = (fxAreaH - kFXGap*2 - kFXPad*2) / 3` computed each `resized()` call and cached in `lastFXAreaH`/`lastFXRowH` for `paint()`. (2) FXRow knob widths: knobs remain fixed-width (`kKnobW = 72`) and pack left-aligned, matching `DelayRow` — a distributing layout was tried at build 360 but widened knobs looked wrong; reverted at 361. | ✅ Closed | 361 |

| 256 | MixerChannel vertical scaling. `kSendH`, `kPanH`, `kTopAreaH` removed as static constants and replaced by proportional locals in `resized()`: sidechain section `scH = jmax(kSidechainH, round(h * 0.20f))`; sends+pan `spH = jmax(4*36, round(h * 0.35f))` distributed as `sendH = spH/4`, `panH = spH - 3*sendH`; fader fills the remainder with 40 px floor. `kSidechainH` and sub-constants kept as minimum floors. | ✅ Closed | 360 |

| 255 | MixerOverlay horizontal scaling. `kChanW = 64` removed as static constant; `chanW = jmax(44, (w - 2*kDivW - masterTotalW - (MaxChannels-1)*kChanGap) / (MaxChannels+3))` computed each `resized()` call and cached as `lastChanW`. Divider positions cached as `lastDivX1`/`lastDivX2` for `paint()`. Master channel now fills remaining horizontal space (`masterActualW = jmax(masterTotalW, w - x)`). | ✅ Closed | 360 |

| 254 | RhythmCircle hit pulse / hub flash were dim and easy to miss (sibling of #252, #253). Pulse alpha bumped from 0.7 → 1.0 on trigger (with matching update to the decay envelope's peak), hub-flash alpha from 0.5 → 0.8. The playhead pulse is now unmistakable as steps cross the 12 o'clock position. | ✅ Closed | 349 |

| 253 | RhythmCircle hits visually fired at 9 o'clock instead of 12 o'clock (sibling of #252). Root cause: `drawRing` and the arc-pulse renderer both used `startOff = -juce::MathConstants<float>::halfPi - rotOff` — that −halfPi was written as if standard math conventions applied (0 = east, π/2 = north), but JUCE's `Path::addCentredArc` measures angles from the TOP (12 o'clock) and increases clockwise. So an angle of −π/2 actually placed step 0 at 9 o'clock (west), and the rotating ring made hits flash at the 9 o'clock anchor. Fix: drop the −halfPi from both `startOff` in `drawRing` and `startA` in the pulse render path so step 0 sits at angle 0 (= 12 o'clock) when rotOff/rotAngleA is 0. Loop-point divider line updated to use the addCentredArc convention (`x = cx + r·sin(angle)`, `y = cy − r·cos(angle)`) instead of standard `cos`/`sin` so the divider and the segment boundaries now share one anchor. | ✅ Closed | 349 |

| 252 | Sidebar mini-circle pattern stuck on the snapshot taken at construction — edits to hits/rotation/steps/insert/pad in the main `EuclideanPanel` updated the main `RhythmCircle` (via `RhythmPanel::refreshCircle`) but never propagated to the sidebar item, so the two circles diverged. Root cause: `SidebarItem::setRhythm` calls `miniCircle.setPatterns(...)` once and the only refresh path was `RhythmSidebar::refreshItems()` (rebuilds all items), which the sidebar timer only triggers when `proc.getNumRhythms() != items.size()` (per #183). Pattern changes within an existing rhythm slot weren't a trigger. Fix: `SidebarItem::timerCallback` (30 Hz) now re-reads `rhythm->genA/B/C.getStepTypes()` and compares against a cached snapshot; only re-pushes to the mini-circle on actual content change so we don't repaint 30×/s. New `cachedPatA / cachedPatB / cachedPatC` members on `SidebarItem`. | ✅ Closed | 349 |

| 251 | Preset dropdown not sorted alphabetically (sibling of #250). `TransportBar::populatePresetDropdown` iterated `dir.findChildFiles(...)` directly — JUCE's filesystem order is platform/FS-dependent (alphabetical on NTFS but not guaranteed elsewhere, mtime on some filesystems), so dropdown order was unpredictable. Fix: explicit `std::sort` on the file list keyed on `getFileNameWithoutExtension().compareIgnoreCase`. `PresetBrowser::refresh` already sorted alphabetically but case-sensitively — switched its comparator to `compareIgnoreCase` for consistency. | ✅ Closed | 348 |

| 250 | Standalone app loads previous session state on startup instead of the user's saved `_default.muclid`. Root cause: JUCE's `StandalonePluginHolder::reloadPluginState()` reads "filterState" from the standalone settings file and calls `setStateInformation()` with it after construction — overwriting the `loadDefaultPreset()` call that the `PluginProcessor` constructor already made. Fix: in `setStateInformation`, when `wrapperType == wrapperType_Standalone` AND `<PresetsDir>/_default.muclid` exists, re-load the default preset and `return` early — JUCE's auto-saved session state is ignored. Behaviour change: standalone session edits are no longer auto-persisted; users must save explicitly (via Save dialog or close-dialog Save button — both already wired) for changes to survive a restart. DAW (non-standalone) path is unaffected so project save/restore continues to work. If the user never saved a `_default.muclid`, JUCE's auto-restore still runs — fresh installs aren't affected. | ✅ Closed | 348 |

| 249 | Master 3-Band EQ insert knobs visually off-centre at 0 dB. User screenshot showed Low/Mid/High all reading "+0.0 dB" but with the High pointer pulled noticeably right of centre and Mid slightly off. Root cause: `setSkewFactor` is sticky on a JUCE `Slider` — when switching algorithms inside the master insert strip, the prior algorithm's log skew (e.g. Compressor's `setSkewFactorFromMidPoint(200)` on insTone, Bitcrusher's `setSkewFactorFromMidPoint(2190)` on insOutput, Tape Sat's `setSkewFactorFromMidPoint(2000)` on insTone) carried over into the ±18 dB EQ knobs. With skew ≈ 0.3 over range -18..+18, the proportional centre (value 0 = position 0.5) renders at `0.5^0.3 ≈ 0.81` — 81% of travel, well past the visual middle. Fix: explicit `getSlider().setSkewFactor(1.0)` on all three insDrive/insOutput/insTone knobs at the top of case 6, restoring linear mapping so 0 dB renders dead-centre. The per-rhythm EQ already does this for driveTone (line 601) but the master path didn't. | ✅ Closed | 347 |

| 248 | 3-Band EQ master insert: Mid Freq knob was missing — master EQ had only Low / Mid gain / High while the per-rhythm EQ exposes all four controls (Low / Mid gain / Mid Hz / High). Root cause: `MixerChannel`'s insert strip had a fixed 3-knob layout (`insDrive` / `insOutput` / `insTone`). Fix: added a 4th `insExtra` knob (hidden by default, visible only in EQ mode). In case 6 of `configureInsertAlgorithm`, `insExtra` is configured as "Mid Hz" (200..8000 Hz, log skew from 1000 Hz) and bound to `mst_insTon` — the same `driveTone` field the audio engine already reads for mid-band centre frequency (`InsertProcessor` case 6: `eqMid.state = makePeakFilter(sr, curMidFreq, 1.0f, midG)`). The `#284` reset-on-algorithm-switch block extended to also reset `mst_insTon` → 1000 Hz when entering EQ mode. `resized()` updated to count `insExtra` in `numVis` so 4-knob EQ mode lays out correctly. No new APVTS param needed — `mst_insTon` was already in `kGlobalParams` and wired through `syncMixerParam`. | ✅ Closed | 352 |

| 247 | Reverb FX row controls now display percentage values (sibling family — applies to all unitless 0..1 FXParamDef entries). `FXRow::rebuildKnobs` extended with three new format branches: `units == "%"` → "X %"; `units == "ms"` → "X ms" / "X.XX s" rolls over at 1000 ms; `minVal == 0 && maxVal == 1` (unitless) → "X %" treating the 0..1 stored value as a percentage. Reverb's Size / Diffusion / Damp / Mod / Dirt controls (all stored 0..1, empty `units`) now show "50 %" instead of "0.50". `Pre-delay` already in ms is unchanged. Effect row Hz formatter (existing) preserved. APVTS storage stays 0..1 — no preset-compat break, formatter only. | ✅ Closed | 346 |

| 246 | GR (gain reduction) meter on the Output knob for Compressor and Limiter inserts. When the Compressor (char=7) or Limiter (char=8) algorithm is active, an orange arc sweeps anti-clockwise from the 5 o'clock position over the Output knob's ring, proportional to current GR (1.0 ≡ 24 dB). `InsertProcessor` gained a `juce::Atomic<float> grReduction` member, reset to 0 at the start of every block and written to the peak per-block GR value in cases 7/8. `KnobWithLabel` now inherits `juce::Timer` privately and adds `setGRSource(const juce::Atomic<float>*)` — when a source is set the knob polls at 30 Hz (instant attack / 0.85-per-frame release ballistics) and repaints. The orange arc is drawn in `paintOverChildren` inside the existing modulation-overlay path. `VoiceEngine::insertProc` moved from private to public so `VoiceSection` can wire the GR source for per-rhythm inserts. `MixerChannel` wires the master insert's GR source from `masterInsertProc->mixerEngine.masterInsert.grReduction`. All non-comp/limiter algorithm paths call `setGRSource(nullptr)` on `insOutput` / `driveOutput` so the timer stops and the arc disappears. | ✅ Closed | 357 |

| 245 | Soft Clip / Hard Clip / Fold insert Drive knob now displays dB instead of raw 0..100. The internal pre-gain formula is `preGain = pow(10, driveDrive/100 × 2)`, so the 0..100 slider linearly maps to 0..40 dB of input gain. Knob now shows e.g. "12.0 dB" at slider value 30. Applied to both `VoiceSection` (per-rhythm insert) and `MixerChannel` (master insert) `configureInsertAlgorithm` cases 1/2/3. Clipper (case 5) uses a different formula (drvDrive as threshold fraction) and keeps raw display — covered by a follow-up. APVTS storage stays 0..100 (no preset-compat break) — formatter only. | ✅ Closed | 346 |

| 244 | 3-Band EQ master-insert Mid knob moved to the middle of the 3-knob column (sibling of #284). `MixerChannel::configureInsertAlgorithm` case 6 slot mapping changed from `insDrive=Low / insOutput=High / insTone=Mid` to `insDrive=Low / insOutput=Mid / insTone=High` so the visual order matches the spectral order. Per-rhythm EQ (VoiceSection) uses a 4-knob horizontal layout and is unaffected. | ✅ Closed | 346 |

| 243 | Master-channel insert algorithm switches but Drive/Output/Tone knobs don't affect the sound (HIGH, user-visible). Reproduce: open standalone, mixer overlay → master channel insert → pick any algorithm (Soft Clip, Bitcrusher, etc.) → turn the Drive knob → no audible change. Root cause in `MixerChannel::configureInsertAlgorithm`: the `setParam` lambda captures the `proc` *parameter*. When the method is re-invoked from `loadFromAPVTS` (which fires every time **any** APVTS parameter changes — and the user touching the algorithm dropdown causes mst_insChar to change, which causes `loadFromAPVTS` to fire), the call passes `proc=nullptr` (to deliberately suppress the algo write-back and avoid feedback loops). The dropdown-write-back guard worked correctly — but the same nullptr propagated into the knob `onValueChanged` lambdas that the method *also* rebinds inside each algorithm case (`insDrive.onValueChanged = [setParam](double v) { setParam("mst_insDrv", v); }`). After any APVTS change, the lambdas were bound to a `setParam` whose `proc` was null, so future user knob movements silently no-op'd: no APVTS write → `parameterChanged` never fires → `masterInsertParams.driveDrive` stays at 0 → InsertProcessor's pre-gain stays at 1 (no audible saturation). A secondary symptom is that the initial knob values were read from `VoiceParams{}` (defaults) when proc was null instead of the live `mixerEngine.masterInsertParams`. Fix: new `PluginProcessor* masterInsertProc` member on `MixerChannel`, captured in `bindMaster`. `configureInsertAlgorithm`'s knob-callback `setParam` lambda now captures `masterInsertProc` instead of the parameter `proc`, so callbacks stay live across reload cycles. The `ip` source for the initial knob values now reads from `masterInsertProc->mixerEngine.masterInsertParams`, so reload shows the engine's current values rather than defaults. The function parameter `proc` retains its existing role — non-null guards the explicit `setParam("mst_insChar", charId)` write-back at the end of each case so feedback loops from loadFromAPVTS are still avoided. | ✅ Closed | 343 |

| 242 | Mixer Effect FX engine/APVTS divergence on state restore (HIGH, user-visible — sibling of #285). `syncFXParam` for `eff_algo` / `rev_algo` had `if (!apvtsLoading) eff.setAlgorithm(...)` — during host-state restore (`apvtsLoading=true`), the algorithm change to APVTS was applied but the engine's `setAlgorithm` was skipped. Nothing re-synced the engine after the load completed, so APVTS held the restored value (e.g. 2 = Phaser) while the engine sat at default (0 = Chorus). Fix: removed the `if (!apvtsLoading)` guards on `eff_algo` and `rev_algo` in `syncFXParam` — `setAlgorithm` rebuild is cheap (one `make_unique` + `prepareInner`), fine to run during state restore. See #285 for the related listener-skip half. | ✅ Closed | 342 |

| 241 | Transport-bar preset dropdown always displays `<unnamed preset>` placeholder, never the currently-loaded preset's name. Root cause in `TransportBar.cpp` `presetDropdown.onChange`: after firing `onPresetSelected(file)` the handler explicitly reset `presetDropdown.setSelectedId(0, false)` — designed to allow re-selecting the same item to trigger a reload, but it left the dropdown showing the placeholder text immediately after every load. Fix: (1) removed the `setSelectedId(0, false)` reset in `onChange` so the dropdown keeps the selected item visible after load; (2) new public `TransportBar::setLoadedPreset(const juce::File&)` method that finds the matching item by full path and selects it (or reverts to placeholder when the file is invalid / not in the dropdown list — e.g. preset saved outside the user Presets dir); (3) `PluginEditor` calls `transportBar.setLoadedPreset(f)` from all three external load paths — `onPresetSelected`, `presetBrowser.onLoadPreset`, and the `saveDialog.onSave` callback (after `refreshPresets()` repopulates so the just-saved item is in the list). Save path mirrors `savePreset`'s filename sanitisation (`\/:\|*?<>"` → `_`, empty → "Preset") to compute the just-saved file path. Host-state restore path (`setStateInformation` / `restoreStateFromTree`) does not set a loaded preset — the placeholder remains correct in that case since the host state isn't a file. | ✅ Closed | 340 |

| 240 | Rhythms silent after `preset A → preset B → preset A` cycle (HIGH). Reproduce: in Bitwig (or any host), load a multi-rhythm preset, hit play, switch to a single-rhythm preset, then switch back to the original — slots beyond #0 visually reload but produce no audio. Root cause: `sequencer.setNumRhythms()` shrinks the active rhythm count by destroying `Rhythm` objects on slots ≥ n, then growing back to the original count re-creates those slots with **default** `Rhythm` fields (`HitGenerator::hits = 0`, default `voiceParams`). When the preset reloads identical APVTS values onto those re-defaulted slots, JUCE's `setValueNotifyingHost` skips the listener callback because the value is unchanged — so `parameterChanged → syncRhythmParam → applyRhythmSuffix` never fires, leaving `r.voiceParams` and `r.genA.hits` at defaults: silent slot. Fix: new private `PluginProcessor::forceSyncRhythmFromAPVTS(int ri)` that iterates every `kRhythmSuffixes` entry and calls `applyRhythmSuffix` directly with the current `apvts.getRawParameterValue()->load()`, bypassing JUCE's unchanged-value skip; internally invokes `sequencer.updatePattern(ri)` when patternDirty and `voiceEngines[ri]->setParams(r.voiceParams)`. Wired into all three preset-load paths: `restoreStateFromTree` (host APVTS state), `loadPreset` (.muclid full presets), `applyRhythmPreset` (.muRhyth single-rhythm presets) — each replacing or augmenting the existing `updatePattern + setParams` pair. Pre-existing bug latent since the `setNumRhythms`-destroys-on-shrink behaviour was introduced; exposed by today's preset-cycle testing. | ✅ Closed | 339 |

| 239 | Modulator Loop / Step multiplier label rendered as garbled glyphs ("Ä□ 4" instead of "× 4"). Root cause: the default-member-initialiser passed `"\xc3\x97"` as `const char*` to NudgeInput's `juce::String` ctor — the implicit conversion was not treating the bytes as UTF-8 in this build configuration. Fix: explicit `juce::String::fromUTF8("\xc3\x97")` for both `loopMult` and `stepMult` so the multiplication-sign codepoint U+00D7 is unambiguously constructed. | ✅ Closed | 330 |

| 238 | Mixer Output dropdown labels updated to descriptive names. `MixerChannel.cpp` ctor now adds "Main" for bus 0 (was "M") and "Out 1" … "Out 8" for buses 1–8 (was raw "1" … "8"). Both the closed dropdown's selected-item text and the popup menu items pick this up automatically. No APVTS or behaviour change. | ✅ Closed | 330 |

| 237 | Modulator state persistence (HIGH). Per-rhythm `controlSequences` and `modulationMatrix.getAssignments()` now serialise to a `Modulators` ValueTree child via new `serialiseModulators(const Rhythm&)` / `deserialiseModulators(const ValueTree&, Rhythm&)` helpers in `PluginProcessor.cpp`. Schema: `<Modulators rhythmIdx="N">` with `<Seq id="csN" mode polarity loopNV loopMod loopMult stepNV stepMod stepMult>` children carrying `<Step v>` and `<Point x y bez hx hy>` elements, plus `<Asgn id src dest depth curve>` entries. Wired into all four save/load paths: `populateStateTree` / `restoreStateFromTree` (host APVTS state), `saveRhythmPresetToFile` / `applyRhythmPreset` (.muRhyth files), `savePreset` / `loadPreset` (.muclid full presets). Deserialise spins on `Rhythm::modLock` so the audio thread cannot be inside `ModulationMatrix::process()` or `ControlSequence::evaluate()` mid-load. New `clearModulators(Rhythm&)` helper resets CS step/curve data + removes all assignments before each load. **File preset paths only clear-and-load when a Modulators child is present**, so legacy .muRhyth / .muclid files (no Modulators child) leave the rhythm's existing in-memory modulators intact — protects freshly-authored work from being wiped by loading a pre-#237 preset. Host APVTS path always restores from the tree's Modulators children (or leaves defaults if absent). Bezier handle flags round-trip exactly; modulator assignments now persist across plugin reloads. | ✅ Closed | 337 |

| 236 | `ModMatrixPanel` ModLock wrapping (HIGH). Every `ModulationMatrix` mutation in `ModMatrixPanel.cpp` is now wrapped in `lockMods(*rhythm)` / `unlockMods(*rhythm)` — namespace-local helpers added at the top of the file that spin on `Rhythm::modLock` (same pattern as `ModulatorEditor::lockMod`/`unlockMod`). Mutations covered: `addAssignment` in the "+ Add Assignment" handler; `removeAssignment` + `addAssignment` in `onDestChange`; `removeAssignment` in `onRemove`; `setDepth` in `onDepthChange`. Previously the audio thread could be inside `ModulationMatrix::process()` iterating `cachedSortOrder` while `addAssignment`'s `rebuildCache()` resized the vector — concurrent read-during-resize was undefined. | ✅ Closed | 332 |

| 235 | `swapRhythms` now holds `rhythmsLock` around the data swap (MEDIUM). `PluginProcessor::swapRhythms` previously relied on `suspendProcessing(true)` alone — but per `PluginProcessor.h:266` that only sets a flag and does NOT block the in-flight `processBlock` callback. Wrapped the entire swap mutation block (`sequencer.swapRhythmSlots`, voice/midi `std::swap`, sidechain re-translation, mixer-channel `std::swap`, env resets) in `{ const juce::ScopedLock sl(rhythmsLock); … }`. The audio thread's `ScopedTryLock` in `processBlock` now bails cleanly (silent block) while we hold the lock. Matches the existing pattern in `removeRhythm` and `handleAsyncUpdate`. | ✅ Closed | 332 |

| 234 | Audio-thread allocation in pattern snapshot eliminated (MEDIUM). `SequencerEngine` ctor now calls `safePatterns[i].reserve(256)` and `safeCPatterns[i].reserve(256)` for all 8 slots (256 = the `resetSteps` cap and `getCombinedPattern`'s LCM clamp). The snapshot copy in `processBlock` switched from `=` copy-assignment (which can allocate when capacity < source size) to `assign(begin, end)` which reuses the existing storage — guaranteed no-alloc on the audio thread for any pattern size ≤ 256 steps. | ✅ Closed | 331 |

| 233 | Negative `beatPos` no longer produces OOB pattern indexing (MEDIUM). `SequencerEngine::processBlock` clamps `globalStep = std::max(0, static_cast<int>(beatPosition / StepLengthBeats))` so hosts emitting negative ppq (pre-roll, REW-past-zero, transport jumps) can't drive `effectiveStep` negative — eliminates the signed-int `%` UB that previously made `pattern[stepIndex]` index a negative offset. | ✅ Closed | 332 |

| 232 | Step-skip on very large blocks fixed (MEDIUM). `SequencerEngine::processBlock` now walks every step crossed between `lastStepIndex[r]` (exclusive) and `stepIndex` (inclusive), so a single huge block (offline render, unusual hosts up to 8192-sample blocks) catches all intermediate hits instead of dropping them silently. Modular forward walk capped at `patLen` to avoid infinite loops on degenerate jumps. `firedMask` stays one bit per rhythm per block (per audit recommendation); `accentMask` reflects the last hit's accent state from `safeCPatterns`. Rhythm-loop-wrap detection (`rhythmLoopWrapMask`) fires whenever the walk reaches step 0. First-call path (`prevStep < 0`) preserved: check current step directly, no back-walk. | ✅ Closed | 332 |

| 231 | `lastEffectiveStep` reset on master-loop change and transport stop→start (MEDIUM). `SequencerEngine::setMasterLoopSteps` now resets `lastEffectiveStep = -1` so a mid-playback loop-length change can't emit a false `masterLoopWrapped` event from the stale value. New `SequencerEngine::resetWrapDetector()` public method; `PluginProcessor::processBlock` detects the `playing` false→true edge (comparing against `sequencerPlaying.get()` from the previous block) and calls it, so a transport stop→start can't trigger a false wrap either. False wraps previously gated hot-swap commits, so this also stops premature staged-swap commits. | ✅ Closed | 331 |

| 230 | `internalBeatPos` and `internalPlaying` are now `std::atomic<>` (MEDIUM). Previously plain `double` / `bool` written by the audio thread (inside `processBlock`) and read+cleared by the UI thread (`isInternalPlaying`, `toggleInternalPlay`) — racy by the C++ memory model. Switched to `std::atomic<double> internalBeatPos` and `std::atomic<bool> internalPlaying`; all read/write call sites updated to use `.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)` / `.store(…, std::memory_order_relaxed)`. No other memory is published through them so relaxed ordering is sufficient. `internalBpm` stays plain — message-thread only. | ✅ Closed | 331 |

| 229 | `ModulatorEditor::setData` now holds `modLock` around `loadFromCS()` (LOW). `loadFromCS()` mutates the live `ControlSequence` in two places: `cs->curvePoints.push_back(...)` when the curve is empty and `cs->stepValues.resize(...)` via `syncStepValues()`. Without the lock the audio thread could be inside `ControlSequence::evaluate()` for that same cs at the moment of the resize. Wrapped the call in `lockMod()`/`unlockMod()`. | ✅ Closed | 330 |

| 228 | `swapRhythmSlots` no longer leaves `lastStepIndex = -1` (LOW). Replaced the `lastStepIndex[i] = lastStepIndex[j] = -1;` pair in `SequencerEngine::swapRhythmSlots` with `patternUpdated[i] = patternUpdated[j] = true;` — the next `processBlock` then runs through the standard snapshot/absorb path which sets `lastStepIndex[r] = effectiveStep % safePatterns[r].size()`, matching `updatePattern`'s semantics. Eliminates the spurious retroactive first-hit fire after a hot-swap. | ✅ Closed | 331 |

| 227 | `getStepTypes` Mute-mode insert zone now reports `StepType::InsertPad` instead of `StepType::Empty` (LOW). `HitGenerator.cpp` updated to emit the pad type for steps inside `[clampedStart, zoneEnd)` so the ring visually distinguishes a muted zone from genuine empty steps — matches the Pad-mode visual identity. Pre/post-pad Mute-mode overwrites already did this; the insert branch was inconsistent. | ✅ Closed | 330 |

| 226 | `EuclideanPanel` rotate slider range updated to `0..steps-1` per design-sequencer.md (LOW). Previously `updateRangesA/B/C` and the ctor defaults clamped rotate to `-(steps/2)..steps/2`, hiding the upper half of the rotate range. `HitGenerator::getPattern` already accepts the full range and handles wrap correctly. | ✅ Closed | 330 |

| 225 | Cubic Bézier evaluator `handleX` documented as deliberately unused (LOW). `ControlSequence::CurvePoint::handleX` retained in the struct for forward-compat — comment added to the struct definition flagging that `evaluateSmooth` is intentionally 1-D in y-over-chord (a true 2-D evaluator complicates the playhead-vs-time mapping and is not free), so anyone authoring presets externally should not expect horizontal-handle effects. | ✅ Closed | 330 |

| 224 | Source-side curve on assignments — implemented Bitwig-style per-assignment bipolar curve knob. New `curve` field on `ModulationAssignment` (range −100..+100, default 0). `ModulationMatrix::process` applies a sign-preserving power bend to each source value before depth scaling: `k = 2^(curve/100)`, `srcVal = sign(srcVal) · \|srcVal/100\|^k · 100`. So curve=0 → linear (k=1), curve=+100 → exponential (k=2, compress low/expand high), curve=−100 → logarithmic (k=0.5, expand low/compress high). New `ModulationMatrix::setCurve(id, value)` API. UI: both `ModulatorEditor::AssignmentRow` and `ModMatrixPanel::MatrixRow` gain a compact rotary curve slider after the depth slider, with double-click-to-zero. `onCurveChange` callback wired into both panels' lock/unlock paths; curve preserved across destination changes. Skipped at curve=0 (one float compare) so unused assignments pay no cost. | ✅ Closed | 334 |

| 223 | Mod-matrix destinations extended (`ModDest::ids` / `labels` / `populate` dropdown). #216 audit identified four desired adds; on re-check `fenv.depth` (filter envelope depth) was already a destination at index 8 — so this batch added three new ones: `pitch.envDepth`, `amp.level`, `accentDb` (appended at array indices 24/25/26 with dropdown IDs 25/26/27 to preserve all existing IDs). New entries in `ModulationMatrix::depthScaleFor`: pitch.envDepth → 24 semitones, amp.level → 2.0 gain (=−∞..+6 dB), accentDb → 12 dB. `PluginProcessor`'s mod-apply block now initialises/snapshots/writes-back each. New `kSnapPitchEnvDep` / `kSnapAmpLvl` / `kSnapAccent` enum entries. `VoiceSection::refreshModulatedIndicators` wires live-arc indicators on `pitchDepth` / `ampLevel` / `ampAccent` knobs. | ✅ Closed | 333 |

| 222 | Cubic Bézier evaluation implemented in `ControlSequence::evaluateSmooth`. When either endpoint of a segment has `hasBezierHandle=true`, the segment renders as a cubic Bézier using control points derived from each endpoint's `handleY` offset relative to the segment midpoint (1-D y-over-chord parameterisation per #225 — `handleX` ignored). When neither endpoint has a handle, the segment falls back to the existing linear interpolation, so current presets (no handle-bearing points saved) render identically. LFOEditor draggable-handle UI deferred. | ✅ Closed | 334 |

| 221 | Legato retrigger mode implemented for all three voice envelopes — engine + APVTS done. Three new bool fields in `VoiceParams`: `pitchEnvLegato` / `filterEnvLegato` / `ampEnvLegato`, all default `false` (= Reset, preserving existing behaviour). Three new APVTS params per rhythm (`pEnvLeg` / `fEnvLeg` / `aEnvLeg`, 8 rhythms × 3 = 24 total) wired through `applyRhythmSuffix` / `pushRhythmToAPVTS` / `kRhythmSuffixes`. `VoiceEngine::trigger` now reads each flag and skips the matching envelope's `reset()` when Legato is on — the envelope continues from its current level, eliminating audible clicks on rapid retriggers in pad/melodic material. UI toggles in `VoiceSection` deferred — accessible via host automation only for now. | ✅ Closed | 334 |

| 220 | Pitch envelope is now fully sample-accurate. New `pitchRatioBuffer` member in `VoiceEngine` (sized in `prepareToPlay` to blockSize, pre-filled with `playbackRatio`); the per-sample loop in `VoiceEngine::process` reads `pitchEnv.getNextSample()` for each sample and computes the pitch ratio inline using `baseSemitones + smoothedPitchMod.getNextValue() + envVal × pitchDepth`. `SamplePlayer::process` signature changed from `double playbackRatio` (one value for the whole block) to `const double* ratios` (one value per sample) so the per-sample ratio buffer drives playback exactly. Pitch envelope on fast transients now traces a smooth curve instead of stair-stepping on block boundaries. Defensive: pitchRatioBuffer auto-resizes if smaller than `ns`; SamplePlayer null-pointer guard added on `ratios`. **Filter envelope** still uses the last sample's value to set the block cutoff target (filter sample-accuracy deferred to a follow-up). | ✅ Closed | 336 |

| 219 | `pitchMod` modulation now smoothed via a 5 ms `SmoothedValue<float, Linear>` member in `VoiceEngine`, read per-sample inside the new per-sample pitch loop introduced by #220 — block-rate steps on modulated pitch are gone. Drive parameter smoothing (driveDrive, driveOutput, etc.) and resonance smoothing remain deferred — both would need additional InsertProcessor / MultiModeFilter restructuring. | ✅ Closed | 336 |

| 218 | Pitch modulation destinations collapsed to a single `pitch.semitones` destination, relabelled "Pitch" in the UI dropdown. `ModulationMatrix::depthScaleFor` for `pitch.semitones` changed from 12 (±1 oct) to 24 (±2 oct full swing — matches the existing `pitchMod` clamp). `PluginProcessor`'s mod-apply block simplified: `pitchMod = jlimit(±24, modParamValues["pitch.semitones"])` (no more `octave × 12 + fine / 100` stacking that silently clipped at ±24). `pitch.octave` / `pitch.fine` removed from `ModDest::populate` dropdown and from the `modParamValues` init / snapshot / write-back code — legacy preset assignments to those destinations still load (destinationId is a string, not an index) but silently no-op at apply time because `paramValues` no longer holds those keys. The strings stay in `ModDest::ids` (deprecated tag) so existing array indices don't shift. `VoiceSection::refreshModulatedIndicators` shows the live-arc only on the Semi knob; pitchOctave/pitchFine knobs lose their live-arc indicators. | ✅ Closed | 333 |

| 217 | Amp envelope time params (`aEnvAtk` / `aEnvDec` / `aEnvRel`) migrated from `0..100` linear → `0..10 seconds` with skew 0.3. New `addAdsrT` factory lambda in `createParameterLayout` wraps `AudioParameterFloat` with seconds-formatting `stringFromValueFunction` ("X ms" below 1 s, "X.XX s" above). `applyRhythmSuffix` writes seconds directly (`juce::jmax(0.001f, v)` instead of `adsrTime(v)`). `pushRhythmToAPVTS` writes seconds directly (no more `*(100/3)` factor); `ampRel` writes 10 (new max) when `ampRelToEnd` is on. End-mode threshold changed from `>= 100` to `>= 10` consistently in both applyRhythmSuffix and the VoiceSection slider. New `formatAdsrTimeSec` / `parseAdsrTimeSec` helpers for the amp sliders; pitch + filter sliders still use the legacy `formatAdsrTime` (0–100 → 0–3 s) pending #286 / #287. `loadFromRhythm` strips the `* (100/3)` conversion for amp values. Sustain stays 0..100 %. UI shows mixed units intentionally during the rollout. **Preset compat**: legacy host-state aEnvAtk/Dec/Rel values stored as floats in 0..100 will clamp to 10 (new max) when loaded — fix in #288. | ✅ Closed | 338 |

| 216 | Filter cutoff knob log-skewed (sibling of #289/#290/#291). APVTS `NormalisableRange(20, 20000, 0, 0.25f)` (skew = 0.25 puts ~1.3 kHz at slider centre — sub-bass region 20–200 Hz now covers ~25% of travel instead of ~1%). UI slider `filterCutoff.getSlider().setSkewFactorFromMidPoint(640.0)` matches. Live-arc snapshot also switched to log normalisation via new `snLogHz` helper so the modulated-position indicator tracks the visible knob position. | ✅ Closed | 335 |

| 193 | Rhythm presets (.muRhyth) now exclude mixer-page state (sibling of #292/#293/#294). The `kChannelSuffixes` save/load loops in `saveRhythmPresetToFile` and `applyRhythmPreset` were stripping channel level/pan/mute/solo/sends/sidechain/output-bus into the rhythm file, contrary to the design intent that rhythm presets carry only sequencer-page state. Sends/sidechain now stay attached to the slot, not the rhythm. Legacy `.muRhyth` files with `ch_*` properties still load — those properties are just ignored. | ✅ Closed | 328 |

| 192 | Comb- filter — new negative-feedback variant of the existing Comb. Type code 15 in `MultiModeFilter`: `y[n] = x[n] − g·y[n−D]`, producing resonant peaks at odd half-multiples of `f0 = sr/D` (f0/2, 3f0/2, 5f0/2…), one octave below the equivalent Comb+ and with the characteristic Karplus-Strong "plucked-string" character. Implementation reuses the existing `combBuffer[ch]` + `combWritePos[ch]` state (only one comb sign is active at a time); the dispatch in `MultiModeFilter::process` merges types 8 and 15 and flips the feedback gain sign for type 15. `fltType` APVTS int range extended 0–14 → 0–15; the `jlimit` guard in `parameterChanged` and the comment on `VoiceParams::filterType` updated to match. `VoiceSection` dropdown gains a "Comb −" item placed next to the renamed "Comb +" entry. | ✅ Closed | 328 |

| 191 | Tempo-synced FX (Delay slot + Echo) used the standalone `internalBpm` regardless of whether the plugin was running standalone or in a DAW — so a host running at any tempo other than 120 produced wrong delay times (the dotted-8th complaint was the visible symptom). Fix in `PluginProcessor::processBlock` just before `fxChain.setHostBpm()`: capture an `effectiveBpm` that prefers `getPlayHead()->getPosition()->getBpm()` when the host provides it, falls back to `midiClockBpmEst.get()` when MIDI clock sync is locked in standalone, and uses `internalBpm` only as a last resort. The sync math itself (`beatMs * 4 / denom × 1.5` for dotted) was already correct — only the BPM input was wrong. | ✅ Closed | 324 |

| 190 | Sidebar drag-reorder — `pushMixerChannelToAPVTS` missing five suffixes (sibling of #295). The function pushed only `lvl/pan/mute/solo/sendEff/sendDly/sendRev` — `scSrc/scAmt/scAtk/scRel/outBus` were defined in `kChannelSuffixes` and registered in APVTS but never written back, so after `std::swap(channels[i], channels[j])` the engine state was correct but APVTS still held the old slot's values and the APVTS→engine listener path eventually overwrote the engine back to stale state. Fixed by adding the five missing `set(...)` calls to `pushMixerChannelToAPVTS`. | ✅ Closed | 324 |

| 189 | Reverb knobs (and effect-row knobs, though less noticeable) would register one mouse drag step then go dead. Root cause in `FXRow::setSelectedAlgorithm`: the method called `rebuildKnobs(currentAlgorithm)` unconditionally, destroying every slider component. `MixerOverlay::loadFromAPVTS` calls `setSelectedAlgorithm(currentAlgo, ...)` on every APVTS refresh tick (30 Hz, triggered when ANY parameter changes — including the very knob the user is dragging), so the user's first drag fired `parameterChanged` → `apvtsDirty` → next tick → knobs rebuilt mid-drag → mouse capture lost on the destroyed slider, subsequent mouseMove events went nowhere. Fix: make `setSelectedAlgorithm` idempotent — early-return when the algorithm index hasn't actually changed, so the typical loadFromAPVTS refresh path becomes a no-op for the row whose algorithm is stable. | ✅ Closed | 324 |

| 188 | Mixer GR meter — permanent grey vertical strip visible on every rhythm channel even when no sidechain ducking is active (sibling of #296/#297). `GRMeter::paint` unconditionally drew its dark `0xff111111` slot background + black border before the fill, so an empty meter still rendered as a thin dark rectangle next to the VU meter — visually indistinguishable from a stuck low-value fill. Fixed by early-returning from `paint` when `displayGR <= 0.005f` (the existing visibility threshold), so the meter is completely invisible until ducking actually occurs. | ✅ Closed | 321 |

| 187 | Lite-build C4702 unreachable-code warning cluster (~80 warnings) eliminated. `PluginProcessor::processBlock` previously gated Lite-only logic with `#if MUCLID_LITE_BUILD { … return; } #endif` followed by full-mode code. In Lite builds the compiler saw the unconditional `return;` inside the always-taken `#if` block and flagged every line of full-mode code (lines 461–765) as unreachable. Refactored to `#if MUCLID_LITE_BUILD … #else … #endif` so only one path is compiled per build target. Three edits: (1) removed the inner `{` after the `#if` and the matching `} // end MUCLID_LITE_BUILD scope` + `return;`; (2) replaced the inner `#endif` with `#else`; (3) added a new `#endif` immediately before `processBlock`'s closing `}`. Behaviour bit-identical for both targets — both branches are mutually exclusive (no shared cleanup; the Lite block already returned naturally). Verified by force-rebuilding `PluginProcessor.cpp` in both targets (`mu-clid` and `mu-clid-lite`) at both Debug and Release configs — zero project warnings. Whole project now compiles warning-free apart from the JUCE `Font(float)` C4996 deprecations explicitly deferred per CLAUDE.md. | ✅ Closed | 315 |

| 186 | Build-warning cleanup — `RhythmCircle` unused `sA` / `sB` locals (sibling of #298). `RhythmCircle.cpp:202–203` C4189 — `sA` and `sB` locals were initialised from `playState->stepsA/stepsB` but never read; ring step indices are derived from `combinedStep % patternA.size()` instead (avoids a race between pattern update and atomic). Both unused variables removed; the surrounding comment rewritten to explain the pattern-size approach. | ✅ Closed | 311 |

| 185 | `MultiModeFilter` notch dry-subtract loops optimised (sibling of #299). SVF type 3 and Ladder type 10 rewritten from per-sample `setSample`/`getSample` to raw `getWritePointer`/`getReadPointer` indexing — same algorithm, ~3–4× faster on the hot path. The inefficiency was inherited from the original `VoiceEngine` code; fixed during the #184 extraction. | ✅ Closed | 305 |

| 184 | Stage 31 — extracted filter dispatch and state from `VoiceEngine` into reusable `MultiModeFilter` (`Source/Audio/MultiModeFilter.h/.cpp`). Class owns the SVF, JUCE LadderFilter, `OnePoleLP[2]`, `OnePoleHP[2]`, `BiquadFilter[2]`, two comb buffers + write positions, and a `notchScratch` `AudioBuffer`. API: `prepare/reset/setType(int)/setCutoff/setResonance/process(buf, ns, nCh)`. Type codes 0–14 unchanged so APVTS `fltType` and saved presets round-trip without remap. `VoiceEngine.h` lost the SVF, ladder, lp6/hp6/eq, comb, and notchBuffer members; `VoiceEngine.cpp` reduced from a ~100-line dispatch ladder to one `voiceFilter.process()` call after the modulated-cutoff calculation. CMakeLists.txt updated for both `mu-clid` and `mu-clid-lite` targets. Build clean (Debug + Release, build 303). Behaviour bit-identical — pure code movement, no DSP changes. | ✅ Closed | 303 |

| 183 | Sidebar shows only 1 rhythm on VST load in Bitwig — when the host calls `setStateInformation()` after the editor is already open (Bitwig does this), the sidebar's one-time `refreshItems()` in the constructor ran before the rhythms were restored, so it only showed the default 1 rhythm. The mixer updates because it listens to APVTS; the sidebar doesn't. Fix: `RhythmSidebar::timerCallback()` (5 Hz) now compares `proc.getNumRhythms()` to `items.size()` and calls `refreshItems()` if they differ, self-correcting within 200 ms of any post-construction state restore. | ✅ Closed | 301 |

| 182 | Stage 30 — filter dropdown UI and APVTS range update. `fltType` APVTS max extended 9 → 14 in `PluginProcessor::createParameterLayout()`. `jlimit` guard updated to match. `VoiceSection` dropdown gains 6 new items in logical display order: HP 6 (type 11), Notch 24 (type 10), AP 12 (type 9), Peak (type 12), Lo Shf (type 13), Hi Shf (type 14). Item IDs 10–15 map to types 9–14 via `id − 1`, preserving existing IDs 1–9 for backwards compatibility. | ✅ Closed | 299 |

| 181 | Stage 30 — three EQ biquad filters (Peak, Lo Shelf, Hi Shelf). New no-alloc `BiquadFilter` struct in `AudioFilters.h` implementing transposed direct-form-II with Audio EQ Cookbook peak/shelf coefficient formulas. Two stereo instances (`eqFilter[2]`) added to `VoiceEngine`. In `process()` for types 12–14: res (0..0.99) → Q (0.1..9.9), gain fixed at +12 dB, coefficients recomputed per-block from `modCutoff` (supports filter envelope sweep). `reset()` called in `prepareToPlay()`. | ✅ Closed | 299 |

| 180 | AP12 filter — type 9 (sibling of #300/#301). 2nd-order all-pass biquad (Audio EQ Cookbook, `BiquadFilter::setAllPass`) — this JUCE version's `StateVariableTPTFilterType` lacks `allPass`, so implemented as a `BiquadFilter` alongside types 12–14. | ✅ Closed | 299 |

| 179 | Filter cutoff parameter display precision — DAW automation lanes showed raw float values with 7+ decimal places (e.g. `6899.6523438`). Added `AudioParameterFloatAttributes().withStringFromValueFunction()` to the `fltCut` APVTS parameter registration in `PluginProcessor::createParameterLayout()`. Formatter: below 1 kHz → `"X.X Hz"`, 1 kHz and above → `"X.X kHz"` (matching the existing `VoiceSection` knob display). Hosts now display `"6.9 kHz"` in automation lanes. | ✅ Closed | 296 |

| 178 | `stopTimer()` added to `RhythmPanel::~RhythmPanel()` before `deregisterRhythmListeners()` (sibling of #302/#303/#304). Prevents timer callback on a partially-destroyed object during the DAW-automation-sync code introduced in #176/#177. | ✅ Closed | 289 |

| 177 | DAW automation UI not syncing (voice + mixer) — same root cause as #176 but for VoiceSection (ADSR, filter, insert, amp, pitch) and MixerOverlay (channel faders, sends, sidechain, FX rows). VoiceSection fix: `RhythmPanel` now also registers APVTS listeners for all 30 voice params (`r{ri}_pitchOct/fltCut/ampLvl/drvChar/…`) and the 3 send params (`ch{ri}_sendEff/Dly/Rev`); `parameterChanged()` now calls `voiceSection.loadFromRhythm()` in addition to the euclid reload. MixerOverlay fix: implements `juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState::Listener` and a private 30 Hz timer; constructor registers for every APVTS parameter; `parameterChanged()` sets `apvtsDirty`; `timerCallback()` and `visibilityChanged()` call `loadFromAPVTS()` when dirty and visible. Destructor deregisters all listeners. | ✅ Closed | 289 |

| 176 | DAW automation UI not syncing — when a DAW (e.g. Bitwig) drives an APVTS parameter via automation, the Euclidean knobs don't move and the RhythmCircle doesn't redraw. Root cause: `EuclideanPanel::wireCallbacks()` only pushes values TO APVTS; there is no reverse path from APVTS back to the UI. Fix: `RhythmPanel` now implements `juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState::Listener` and registers as a listener for all 31 Euclidean parameter IDs of the currently displayed rhythm. `parameterChanged()` calls `euclidPanel.loadFromRhythm()` (syncs all knobs) and `refreshCircle()` (redraws pattern). Listeners are deregistered for the old rhythm and registered for the new one whenever `setRhythm()` is called, and deregistered in the destructor. JUCE fires APVTS listeners on the message thread after `PluginProcessor::parameterChanged()` has already updated the Rhythm struct, so the reads are always of the fresh state. | ✅ Closed | 285 |

| 175 | Filter dropdown reorder + feedback comb filter — UI dropdown reordered to LP 6 / LP 12 / LP 24 / BP 12 / BP 24 / HP 12 / HP 24 / Notch / Comb. New feedback comb filter (type 8): circular buffer (max delay = sr/20 Hz + 4 samples), linear interpolation, feedback gain from `filterRes` (0–0.99). Cutoff maps to resonant peak frequency via `delayF = sr / cutoff`. `VoiceEngine::prepareToPlay` allocates `combBuffer[ch]` and clears `combWritePos`. `VoiceParams.h` comment updated to include type 8=Comb. | ✅ Closed | 284 |

| 174 | Standalone close dialog — Save button does nothing useful. `pluginHolder->savePluginState()` dumped raw JUCE state instead of showing the SaveDialog. Fix: added `std::function<void(std::function<void()>)> onSaveAndQuit` to `PluginProcessor`; `PluginEditor` wires it up to open the SaveDialog and call the quit callback on completion (or clear it on cancel). `StandaloneApp.cpp` Save branch now calls through the hook; falls back to raw state save + quit if the editor is not initialised. | ✅ Closed | 282 |

| 173 | VST3 not loading in Ableton Live — plugin loads in Bitwig but is rejected by Ableton at scan time. Root cause: `IS_SYNTH FALSE` in `CMakeLists.txt` causes JUCE to emit the `kFx` VST3 category; Ableton strictly requires `kFx` plugins to have an audio input bus, and since mu-Clid has no audio input (it is a sample-based drum machine, MIDI in → audio out), Ableton silently rejects it. Bitwig does not enforce this rule. Fix: changed `IS_SYNTH FALSE` → `IS_SYNTH TRUE` in the `juce_add_plugin(mu-clid ...)` block; JUCE now emits `kInstrument` category, which Ableton accepts for plugins with only audio output. No effect on audio processing, bus layout, or MIDI routing. Testers must delete Ableton's plugin cache (Preferences → Plug-ins → Rescan) after installing the new build. | ✅ Closed | 277 |

| 172 | Standalone close dialog — OK closes dialog but not the app. Root cause: `juce::JUCEApplicationBase::quit()` (static) calls `app->systemRequestedQuit()`, which in `MuClidApp` delegates to `closeButtonPressed()`, opening a second dialog immediately after the first closes. Testers see the first dialog dismiss with no apparent effect. Fix: replaced `juce::JUCEApplicationBase::quit()` with `juce::JUCEApplication::getInstance()->quit()` in both branches of the async callback; the instance method calls `MessageManager::stopDispatchLoop()` directly, bypassing `systemRequestedQuit()`. | ✅ Closed | 277 |

| 171 | Insert panel knob sizing — master insert panel `resized()` rewritten to be visibility-aware: only visible knobs are stacked, and height scales up to 80 px each (was capped at 40 px). With a typical 522 px channel height and 3 visible knobs, each knob now renders at 80 px (radius ≈ 31 px), vs the previous 11 px radius that made them look tiny. For 2-knob algorithms (Ring Mod) the two knobs each get 80 px. None hides all knobs. Layout uses `ky` cursor that only advances for visible knobs, so there is no gap where a hidden knob would have been. | ✅ Closed | 272 |

| 170 | Insert effect names — alphabetical order and clearer names. Both `insCharBox` (MixerChannel) and `driveChar` dropdown (VoiceSection) now list effects alphabetically after "None": 3-Band EQ, Bitcrusher, Clipper, Compressor, Fold, Hard Clip, Limiter, Ring Mod, Soft Clip, Tape Sat. "Soft" renamed to "Soft Clip" and "Hard" renamed to "Hard Clip" to make the DSP character obvious. Item IDs are unchanged so existing APVTS presets round-trip correctly. `kInsertNames[]` in `ModulatorEditor.h` and comments in `InsertProcessor.cpp`, `VoiceParams.h`, and `VoiceSection.cpp` updated to match. | ✅ Closed | 272 |

| 169 | Extended voice filter bank (Stage 29) — four new filter types added to the voice filter slot, fitting within the pre-declared `fltType` APVTS range 0–9. Types 4–6 use `juce::dsp::LadderFilter<float>` (LP24/HP24/BP24): warm 4-pole analog-style filter with resonance (0–0.99) mapped directly from `filterRes`; filter envelope and modulation matrix both work with the new types. Type 7 (LP 6) uses the existing `OnePoleLP` 1-pole IIR per channel, coefficient computed from `modCutoff` each block. `syncFilter()` now routes by type to configure the correct filter object. UI: four items added to the `filterType` dropdown in `VoiceSection` (LP 24 / HP 24 / BP 24 / LP 6). Existing types 0–3 (LP/HP/BP/Notch via SVF) unchanged. | ✅ Closed | 282 |

| 168 | Sidechain GR showing with no source selected — on standalone startup, rhythm channel GR meters showed GR even though the source dropdown showed "—". Root cause: in standalone, APVTS state is restored (via `setStateInformation`) **before** the editor is created, so if the saved state had `scSrc > 0`, `parameterChanged` correctly set `channels[r].sidechainSource` in the engine, but the mixer UI was never told — `loadFromAPVTS()` was only called in preset-load callbacks, not at editor construction. Fix: added `mixerOverlay.loadFromAPVTS()` call at the end of `PluginEditor` constructor so the scSourceBox and all mixer controls always reflect the restored APVTS state on startup. | ✅ Closed | 276 |

| 167 | Standalone close warning — confirmation dialog shown before the standalone app exits. Implemented via `JUCE_USE_CUSTOM_PLUGIN_STANDALONE_APP=1`: custom `MuClidApp` / `MuClidWindow` classes in `Source/StandaloneApp.cpp`. `closeButtonPressed()` override shows a non-blocking `AlertWindow` with OK / Save / Cancel buttons (JUCE LookAndFeel_V2 assigns returnValue 1, 2, 0 respectively for the 3-button layout — Cancel/Escape gets 0); Save calls `pluginHolder->savePluginState()` then quits; OK quits without saving; Cancel/Escape leaves the app open. `systemRequestedQuit()` delegates to `closeButtonPressed()`. `dialogOpen` guard prevents double-dialogs on rapid close attempts. | ✅ Closed | 275 |

| 166 | Tape Saturation insert effect (Stage 28) — new driveChar=10 algorithm in `InsertProcessor`. DSP: pre-gain (1–10×) → `tanh` soft saturation → DC block (HP at ~20 Hz, per-channel `dcBlockIn/Out[2]` state) → 1-pole LP tone filter (reuses `toneFilter[2]`) → output trim. Parameters reuse existing APVTS: `drvDrv` → Drive (0–100%), `drvTon` → Tone LPF (200–20000 Hz), `drvOut` → Output (−24..0 dB). Available on both per-rhythm voice inserts and master insert (mst_insChar=10). UI: case 10 in VoiceSection and MixerChannel `configureInsertAlgorithm` with Drive/Output/Tone labels. | ✅ Closed | 271 |

| 165 | Ring Modulator insert effect (Stage 27) — new driveChar=9 algorithm in `InsertProcessor`. DSP: per-sample `data[i] *= (1 − mix + sin(phase) × mix)`, per-channel `ringPhase[2]` accumulates at `2π·freq/sr` per sample. Parameters reuse existing APVTS: `drvDrv` → Mix (0–100%), `drvTon` → Freq (10–5000 Hz, log-scaled). Available on both per-rhythm and master inserts. APVTS `drvChar` range extended 0–8 → 0–10; all jlimit guards updated in PluginProcessor and MixerChannel. UI: case 9 in VoiceSection and MixerChannel `configureInsertAlgorithm` with Mix + Freq knobs; Freq skew set for log feel. | ✅ Closed | 271 |
